data.help_category-faq-001|contents[0].text:
Raising an Idol's Lv increases their stats, allowing you to earn higher scores.
Don't forget to level up your Idols.
The "Lesson Pieces" needed for leveling up can be obtained from:
-Self-Training
-Work > Promotion
-Live > Daily Live
-Shop > Market
and other places.

If you can't win, waiting a while is another option.
Simply leaving the game for a set time lets you earn Lesson Pieces and other rewards from "Self-Training," making you stronger.
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[0].title: Have you raised your Idols' Lv?
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[1].text:
Every Live has a lane with an SP Skill chance.
Place an Idol with an SP Skill in that lane.
SP Skills can earn very high scores.
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[1].title: Are your SP Skills activating?
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[2].text:
The number and frequency of A Skill chances differ by lane.
Skills have a "CT," and once a Skill activates it cannot activate again until its CT reaches 0.
If you've placed an Idol with an A Skill but the Skill isn't activating:
-Place Idols whose Skills have a short CT
-Place Idols that have two A Skills
Try different setups so that your Skills activate.
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[2].title: Are your A Skills activating?
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[3].text:
If Mental or Fan Count is insufficient, Skill success rates drop and Skills may fail.
Mental can be raised with Sub Accessories and Photos,
and Fan Count can be raised with Work
by increasing Fan Count and Core Fan Rate.
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[3].title: Are Mental and Fan Count sufficient?
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[4].text:
■ Skill Cannot Activate
A Skill effect or similar has put you in a state where Skills cannot activate.

■ Skill Not Learned
The Idol does not have the Skill that matches the Skill chance.
Place an Idol with an SP Skill in lanes with an SP Skill chance, and an Idol with an A Skill in lanes with an A Skill chance.

■ Use Limit Reached
The Skill has reached its use limit.

■ On CT
The Skill could not activate because it is on CT.
Place Idols whose Skills have a short CT, or Idols that have two A Skills.

■ Insufficient Stamina
You lack the Stamina needed to activate the Skill.
Place Idols with Stamina recovery Skills, or raise Stamina with Accessories.

■ Skill Failed
Mental was insufficient and the Skill missed.
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[4].title: Why Skills don't activate
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[5].text:
In a Live, each lane has a tendency.
The score earned from Skill chances in a Vocal-tendency lane is determined by the Vocal stat of the Idol placed there.
Matching a lane's tendency with the Idol's strong stat raises the score earned by Skills.

The tendencies are as follows.
-Pink: Vocal
-Blue: Dance
-Yellow: Visual
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[5].title: Are you matching lane tendencies?
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[6].text:
By consuming three of the same Accessory plus Coins, you can obtain an Accessory one ★ (rarity) higher.
Combine Accessories to get stronger ones, then equip them to suit each Live to earn higher scores.
data.help_category-faq-001|contents[6].title: Are you combining your Accessories?
data.help_category-faq-002|contents[0].text:
Live Battles refer to Live modes where you face an opponent, such as "VENUS Battle."
In Live Battles you compete with your opponent for Skill chances, so winning those chances is crucial.
The Idol with the highest stat matching each lane's color wins the Skill chance.
data.help_category-faq-002|contents[0].title: Tips for winning
data.help_category-faq-002|contents[1].text:
If your opponent keeps stealing Skill chances, check the following.
-Is your Idols' Lv lower than your opponent's?
-Do the lane tendencies match your Idols' tendencies?
-Are you short on Stamina or Stamina recovery Skills?
-Are your Accessories and Photos suited to the tendency and the Live?
data.help_category-faq-002|contents[1].title: Winning Skill Chances

The Song, stage, Work, or Story content you shoot does not affect a Photo's quality, rarity, or options.
The outcome of a Photo you take does not affect its quality, rarity, or options.

Trust can increase through "Conversations with Idols," "Messages," and "Photo Shoots."
You can check current Trust from 【Management】 or 【Menu > Roster】.

For some content, you are assigned automatically so that no differences arise based on when you started the game.
Once you reach a certain Manager Lv, you are assigned to an initial Group based on your start time and each Group's size.
You can check your current Group from 【Menu > Name Card】.
You can also change Groups from 【Menu > Account】.

You can move to a Group whose average Manager Lv is equal to or higher than your initial Group's.
After moving, you can move again at any time as long as it is within the above Groups.
Moving Groups changes Union, Ranking, and VENUS Program elements.

data.help_category-faq-008|contents[0].text:
When the Operations Team receives an inquiry from a Manager, we send an automated acknowledgment email to the email address you entered when contacting us.
Please check whether this acknowledgment email has arrived.
If it has not, the following reasons are possible.

-The email address you entered is incorrect.
-The acknowledgment email was sorted into your spam or trash folder.
-You normally only receive emails from specific domains.

We apologize for the trouble, but before contacting us, please recheck your email address and your various settings.
If you use domain-specific receiving, please configure it so that emails from "@idolypride.jp" can be received.
Also, even if you receive the automated reply, depending on the content of your inquiry it may take time before we reply.
Thank you for your understanding.

data.help_category-help-accessory|contents[0]:
Here you can view, combine, sell, and limit break your Accessories.

■ Accessory Details
They take effect when equipped to support an Idol in Unit formation.
Accessory slots are divided into "Main" and "Sub," and you can equip one of each.
Accessories currently equipped in a Unit are not shown in the Accessory list.

■ Main and Sub
Main: Equip Accessories related to an Idol's Vocal, Dance, and Visual.
Sub: Equip Accessories related to an Idol's Stamina, Mental, and Critical.
data.help_category-help-accessory|contents[1]:
Combining Accessories lets you obtain more powerful Accessories.

■ Accessory Combining Details
You can combine Accessories with lower effects as materials to create higher ones.
Basically, three of the same Accessory can be combined into one Accessory with an effect one step higher.
For Accessories that have enough materials and Coins, the total number of materials is displayed and they can be combined.


■ Accessory Combining Targets
The Accessories to be used in Accessory combining can be set at the time of combining.

-"Standard"
Combines without including Accessories currently equipped.

-"Excluding VENUS League"
Combines all Accessories not currently equipped in VENUS League.
Note that combined Accessories are removed from your formation.

-"All"
Combines all Accessories.
Note that if you combine Accessories equipped in VENUS League during a VENUS League match, it may affect the VENUS League results.


■ Accessory Combining Notes
The Coins required for combining differ by step.
Accessories equipped in a Unit do not appear in the Accessory combining list and are excluded from combining.
data.help_category-help-accessory|contents[2]:
You can sell Accessories you own to earn Coins.
Accessories currently equipped are excluded from selling.
data.help_category-help-accessory|contents[3]:
Limit breaking an Accessory at its final step further increases its effect.

■ Accessory Limit Break Details
Accessories at their final step can be limit broken using Spirit Risers and Coins.
For Accessories that can be limit broken, including those equipped, the total number of items to be used is displayed and they can be limit broken.
A limit break value is shown in the upper-left of limit broken Accessories.
Accessory limit breaks have a maximum value.

■ Accessory Limit Break Notes
The items and Coins required for a limit break differ by step.
After a limit break, you cannot return to the state before it.
Accessory limit breaks become available after clearing Main Live #83.
data.help_category-help-account|contents[0].t:
You can share data and play across multiple devices.

■ Account Linking
You can link this service's game data between devices that have performed Account Linking.
Each account can link only one set of game data.
If the linked account already has game data, the data you are currently playing will be overwritten.

■ Link Password
You can link by setting a password.
On the destination device, you must enter your Manager ID and the password you set.

■ Account Linking Notes
Blue Diamonds purchased in the app cannot be shared between devices with different OSes.
Blue Diamonds purchased from the Web Shop can be shared between devices with different OSes.
data.help_category-help-account|contents[1].t:
All Managers are assigned to a "Group" based on their start time and numbers.

■ Moving Groups
Using the average Manager Lv of the Group you first joined as a baseline, you can move if the destination Group's average Manager Lv is higher.
If you meet the conditions, you can move Groups at any time.
Moving Groups changes Union, Ranking, and VENUS Program elements.

■ Notes on Unions
You will belong to the Union of the destination Group.
You will automatically join the Union with the same name as your current Union.
Union Medals carry over to the destination Group.
Staff Training Lv carries over to the destination Group.
All Union Live earned Pt is reset, and your Union ranking starts from the bottom.

■ Notes on Rankings
You will participate in the destination Group's rankings for the following:
Fan Event
High Score Live
VENUS Battle
Union Live
Your previous rank and score are all reset.
Your profile's all-time best rank inherits your current best rank.

■ Notes on the VENUS Program
After moving Groups, reflection is suspended for 14 days, and you are excluded from the rankings and from being the fastest VENUS Rank achiever.
VENUS Points you hold in your current Group carry over as is.
Achiever rewards you have already received cannot be received again.
VENUS Points are still gained and lost during the suspension.
data.help_category-help-account|contents[2].t:
You can delete your play data without uninstalling the app.
After a data reset, you start from the tutorial.
Note that data cannot be restored.
In Work, you can earn Fans, raise Core Fan Rate, and recover Energy.

■ Work Details
There are three types of Work: Fan Event, Promotion, and Refresh.
Work progresses over time even while you are not playing the game.
Also, depending on the type of Work, you can earn various rewards.

■ Costumes and Hairstyles during Work
When selecting the Idols to do Work, you can change their costumes and hairstyles.
The costumes you can select differ by Work content, and some Work does not let you select costumes or hairstyles.

■ Work Lv
Each Idol has a Work Lv, which increases by doing Work.
Raising Work Lv increases the maximum Energy.
Also, the Work Lv cap is unlocked as you progress through Main Live.

■ Energy
"Fan Event" and "Promotion" continue until Energy reaches zero.
You can recover Energy over time or with "Refresh."
Time-based recovery restores 1 Energy every 30 seconds.
Energy does not recover while Work is in progress or while Work completion is pending.

■ Fan Count and Core Fan Rate
These affect the number of Fans attending a Live.
For details, see "Help > Live > ■ Attending Fan Count."
You can raise Core Fan Rate according to the "Fan Satisfaction" at the end of a Fan Event and earn rewards.

■ Fan Event Details
Select three Idols to start a Fan Event.
The efficiency of earning Fan Satisfaction changes depending on the type and Lv.
A Fan Event cannot be ended partway through.
It ends when the Energy of all Idols doing the Fan Event reaches zero.

■ Fan Letters and Support
Fans holding Fan Letters may appear.
Receiving a Fan Letter raises the "Support Gauge."
When the Support Gauge fills, you can call other Idols to support.
While other Idols are supporting, the efficiency of earning Fan Satisfaction increases.

■ FEVER State
Consume a "Fever Drink" to enter the FEVER state for a certain time.
During the FEVER state, the efficiency of earning Fan Satisfaction increases.
During the FEVER state, tapping with good timing increases the efficiency of earning Fan Satisfaction.

■ Fan Event Lv
Doing Fan Events raises the Fan Event Lv.
Raising the Fan Event Lv increases that Fan Event's efficiency.
Progressing through Main Live raises the Lv cap of each Fan Event.
Each Fan Event Lv has a Core Fan Rate cap, and if an Idol's Core Fan Rate has reached the cap, it will not increase.
The Core Fan Rate cap also changes depending on the Idol's Fan Count.

■ Rankings
From Rankings, you can check the High Score ranking within your Group.

■ Core Fan Rate
This affects the number of Fans attending a Live.
For details, see "Help > Live > ■ Attending Fan Count."

■ Earned Items
You can earn rewards by doing Fan Events.
The following Fan Events may yield "Photo Recipes":
-Handshake Event: Lv 6 or higher
-Photo Session: Lv 4 or higher
-Autograph Session: Lv 2 or higher
Also, consuming "Sweets Gift" doubles item earning efficiency.
You can earn Fans over time and obtain rewards.

■ Promotion Details
To do a Promotion, you must select three Idols.
Efficiency changes depending on the type and Lv of the Promotion.
A Promotion can be ended partway through.
If ended partway, you earn the Fans gained and rewards obtained up to that point.

■ Promotion Lv
Doing Promotions raises the Promotion Lv.
Raising the Promotion Lv increases that Promotion's efficiency.
Progressing through Main Live raises the Lv cap of each Promotion.
Each Promotion Lv has a cap on the Fans that can be earned, and if an Idol's Fan Count has reached the cap, Fans will not increase.

■ Shortening Promotion Time
You can shorten Promotion time by consuming "Skip Watches" or "SP Skip Watches."

■ Fan Count
This affects the number of Fans attending a Live.
For details, see "Help > Live > ■ Attending Fan Count."

■ Earned Items
You can earn rewards by doing Promotions.
The following Promotions may yield "Retouch Ink":
-Advertising: Lv 12 or higher
-Photo Shoot: Lv 6 or higher
-Appearance: Lv 6 or higher
The following Promotions may yield "Spirit Risers":
-Advertising: Lv 45 or higher
-Photo Shoot: Lv 40 or higher
-Appearance: Lv 40 or higher
Idols' Energy can be recovered over time.

■ Refresh Details
Refresh is performed by consuming Coins.
The required Coins, recovery amount, and required time differ by Refresh content.
A Refresh cannot be ended partway through.

■ Shortening Refresh Time
You can shorten Refresh time by consuming "Hourglasses."
data.help_category-help-company|contents[0].t:
You can check the rank and position of your "Office Points."

■ Office Rank Details
Office Rank rises when "Office Points" exceed a specified cumulative total.
"Office Points" are the sum of "Interaction Pt," "Achievement Pt," and "Attendance Pt."

■ Interaction Details
You can earn "Interaction Pt" for each Idol by giving presents or clearing Missions.
Interaction Pt and Interaction Lv differ by Idol, and exceeding a specified cumulative total raises that Idol's Interaction Lv.

■ Achievement Details
You can earn "Achievement Pt" by clearing Achievement Missions.
Exceeding a specified cumulative total raises your Achievement Lv.

■ Attendance Details
At 12:00 on the last day of each month, you earn Diamonds according to your month's activity and Attendance Pt according to your salary.
Measurement runs until 23:59 on the day before each month's last day, and the last day is not counted.
You can earn rewards by clearing Training.
Each Training is unlocked according to game progress.

■ Rules
Each Training has a set theme, and you aim to clear the Live by devising your Idol, Photo, and Accessory formation.
When the score earned in the Live reaches the target score, that Training is cleared.

■ Hints
Refer to the hints provided for each Training as you aim to clear the Live.
You can check hints before challenging the Live, but failing the Live once reveals more detailed hints.
data.help_category-help-gacha|contents[0].tex:
You can spend Diamonds or dedicated items to recruit Idols or obtain items.

■ Gacha Details
The Idols you can recruit and items you can obtain differ by Gacha.
You can check your history from Gacha History.

■ Gacha Result Screen
You can check Idols, items, and Gacha Pt.
If an Idol you already have appears, they are automatically exchanged for Bloom Pt and "Idol Medals."
If Bloom Pt reaches the required amount, Blooming is performed automatically.

■ Gacha Pt Exchange
In some Gachas, you earn 1 Gacha Pt per Gacha pull.
You can spend Gacha Pt to exchange for Idols.
The Idols available for exchange differ by Gacha.
Gacha Pt has an expiration date.
Gacha Pt past its expiration is automatically exchanged for "Common Gacha Pt."
data.help_category-help-gacha|contents[1].tex:
You can spend Diamonds or Gacha Tickets to recruit Idols.

■ Diamond Gacha Notes
In Diamond Gacha, you cannot exchange Gacha Pt for Idols.
data.help_category-help-gacha|contents[2].tex:
You can spend "Assist Tickets" to recruit Idols or obtain items.

■ Assist Ticket Gacha Details
You can pull the Gacha by collecting a specified number of Assist Tickets.

■ Where to Get Assist Tickets
Assist Tickets are mainly obtained from Work, the VENUS Tower, and Events.
data.help_category-help-home|contents[0].text:
You can receive earned rewards.

■ Gift Details
Some Gifts have an expiration date.
Rewards whose expiration has passed can never be received again.

■ Receipt History
You can check the history of Gifts you have received.
data.help_category-help-home|contents[1].text:
You can check and receive the reward contents of various Bonuses.

■ Daily Bonus Details
It can be received once per day.
It updates every day at 00:00.
When you log in, your cumulative login days are counted.

■ Photo Report Details
You can receive one Photo per day based on the Lives and Work you did up to the previous day.
The Photo Report updates every day at 00:00.
If you did not do any Lives or Work the previous day, you may not be able to receive a Photo.
The quality of the Photo you receive differs depending on your Manager Lv.
If you do not receive it and 00:00 passes, the previous day's Photo Report is lost.
data.help_category-help-home|contents[2].text:
You can check Mission contents and receive completion rewards.

■ Mission Details
You can receive rewards by meeting specified conditions.
Rewards not received before the update are lost even if you completed them.

■ Update Timing
Daily Missions: Contents update every day at 00:00.
Weekly Missions: Contents update every Monday at 00:00.

■ Added Missions and Increased Rewards
Some Daily and Weekly Missions have increased rewards according to Manager Lv at the update timing.
Some Missions are also unlocked according to Manager Lv and Main Live progress.
Between updates, Missions will not be unlocked or have their rewards increased partway through.
data.help_category-help-home|contents[3].text:
You can purchase items useful in the game.

■ Diamond Shop
You can purchase Diamonds.

■ Shop
You can purchase great-value packs containing items useful in the game.

■ Market
You can purchase items by spending Coins or Diamonds.
Products available in the Market are randomly discounted.

■ Market Updates
Product contents update automatically every day at 00:00 and 12:00.
You can also update product contents yourself from "Update."
The update limit is 10 times, and the first update is free.
After that, Diamonds are consumed, and the amount differs according to the number of updates.
The number of updates resets every day at 00:00 and 12:00.
data.help_category-help-home|contents[4].text:
You can set the Idols to display on each of the "Home," "Training," and "Work" screens.
Other Idols appear at random from Idols excluding Memories and Collab, and new Idols appear after a set time passes.


■ How to Set
You can do this from "Management > Tap a character icon > Placement Settings."

■ Idols
You can set the Idol to display on each screen.
Setting Auto randomly displays different Idols after a set time passes.

■ Costumes
You can set "Work Costumes" and "Auto Costumes" for each Idol.
Setting Auto Costumes makes the Idol wear different costumes after a set time passes.
data.help_category-help-idle|contents[0].text:
For each Idol, you can set a favorite costume, check owned costumes, change costumes, and change hairstyles.

■ Setting a Favorite Costume
The favorite costume set in Dress Up becomes the costume worn on Home.
Also, the favorite costume is applied automatically during Unit formation.

■ Hairstyle Feature
The Hairstyle feature lets you change each Idol's hairstyle to a specific one.
Some costumes cannot be combined with certain hairstyles.
Some hairstyles can have dedicated hair ornaments set on them.
data.help_category-help-idle|contents[1].text:
You can exchange messages with Idols. You may also receive phone calls.

■ Message Details
You can exchange messages with Idols.
Message contents change according to the Idol's "Trust."
Exchanging messages may raise the Idol's Trust.

■ Phone Details
You can talk on the phone with Idols.
Phone contents change according to the Idol's "Trust."

■ Push Notifications
Messages from Idols arrive even while you are not playing the game.
By turning ON push notifications, you can receive notifications when a message arrives.
data.help_category-help-idle|contents[2].text:
You can talk with the Idols appearing on Home.

■ Conversation Details
You can talk with Idols who have an icon displayed.
Talking about new content raises the Idol's Trust.
data.help_category-help-idle|contents[3].text:
Memories are special Idols from a different time and world.
Memories cannot be sent to Work, and their Fan Count and Core Fan Rate are the average of all Idols.
data.help_category-help-idle|contents[4].text:
Collab Idols, like Memories, are special Idols from a different time and world.
They cannot be sent to Work, and their Fan Count and Core Fan Rate are the average of all Idols.
data.help_category-help-idle|contents[5].text:
IIIX members have some restrictions in their performance.
Their Fan Count, Core Fan Count, and Work Lv when recruited are the average of all Idols.
data.help_category-help-idle|contents[6].text:
Bond Awakening Limited Idols are special Idols who undergo Bond Awakening when you obtain the target Idol twice.
Bond Awakening changes their illustration and lets you obtain a second costume or unlock a fourth Skill.
data.help_category-help-lesson|contents[0].te:
You can earn Manager Exp, Coins, Lesson Pieces, and Level Assist Pt over time.

■ Self-Training Details
It progresses over time even while you are not playing the game, and tapping earns rewards for the elapsed time.
Rewards accumulate for up to 12 hours.
Earning efficiency increases according to Main Live progress.
data.help_category-help-lesson|contents[1].te:
You can instantly earn 2 hours' worth of Self-Training rewards.

■ Self-Training Time Shortening Details
You can do this up to 5 times per day.
The first time each day is free, and after that each use consumes 50 Diamonds.
The number of available uses updates every day at 00:00.
Separately from the up-to-5-times-per-day time shortening, you can also instantly earn 2 hours' worth of rewards by consuming a "Gyogyotto-san Drink."
"Gyogyotto-san Drink" can be used after doing the free time shortening once per day.
data.help_category-help-live|contents[0].text:
You can form a Unit and challenge Lives.

■ Live Overview
You earn score through Beats and Skill chances set to the Song, and clear the Live by reaching the target score.
Some Lives have a score rank, and you clear the Live by earning a score of C rank or higher.
Clearing a Live earns rewards.

■ Venue Seats
The maximum number of attending Fans.

■ Attending Fan Count
You can check the number of attending Fans and its breakdown.
The attending Fan Count is determined by Fan Count and Core Fan Rate.
Fan Count: Represents each Idol's number of Fans.
Core Fan Rate: Represents the proportion of Fans who will attend.
According to the attending Fan Count, your score, SP Skill success rate, and A Skill success rate increase.

■ Target Score
Reaching it clears the Live.

■ Song Lv
Represents the Live's difficulty.

■ Song Lane Tendencies
Represents the stats that affect A Skill and SP Skill scores.

■ Lane Info
You can check Skill activation frequency and order.
"SP": Represents whether an SP Skill is placed.
"Low"/"High": Represents the amount of placed A Skills.

■ Live Details
Clear Rewards: Rewards earned upon clearing the Live.
Live Features: You can check the features set for each Live.
Active Live Cheers: You can check the breakdown of Live Cheers that activate during the Live.
Cheer Activating Idols: You can check the Idols whose Cheers are activating.
Recent Clear: You can watch or analyze the Live of the Manager who most recently cleared it.

■ What You Can Check During a Live
You can check the score earned in time with Beats and Skill chances.
Skills activate in time with the incoming Skill chances.
Skill success rates differ according to the Idol's Mental and the Live's required Mental.
When a Critical occurs, you can earn more score than usual.

■ What You Can Check After a Live
You can check the earned score and its breakdown.
In "Lane Info," you can check whether Skills activated.
In "Replay," you can review the Live footage.
In "Analysis," you can analyze the Live in more detail.

■ Skipping a Live
By checking "Live Skip," you can skip the Live and watch only the "Highlight."

■ Highlight
You can quickly check only each Idol's Skill activation results and earned score.
You can press and hold the screen to view at double speed.

■ Live Notes
The required Mental and Critical differ depending on the Live.
data.help_category-help-live|contents[1].text:
Clearing them earns rewards. Also, various features are unlocked as you progress through Main Live.

■ Main Live Details
Lives within a venue can be challenged in any order.
No items are consumed, and you can challenge as many times as you like.
Lives you have cleared once cannot be rechallenged.
Clearing all Lives in a venue unlocks the next venue.
Some venues cannot be challenged unless your Manager Lv reaches the specified Lv.
data.help_category-help-live|contents[2].text:
You can spend various Passes to do Lives and earn specified rewards.

■ Daily Live Details
There are three types of Daily Live where you can earn Coins, Lesson Pieces, and Shooting Film.
Each can be challenged by consuming a Coin Pass, Lesson Pass, or Shooting Pass respectively.
Rewards differ by each Live's difficulty.
You can also earn bonus rewards according to your score rank.
If you fail to clear it, the Pass is not consumed.

■ FREE Passes
Every day at 00:00, you earn 5 FREE Passes for each Live.
FREE Passes from the previous day that were unused as of 0:00 are lost.

■ Batch Play for FREE Passes
In Batch Play, the highest difficulty of a cleared Daily Live is executed with the formation from your last play.
Note that Daily Lives eligible for Batch Play are only those cleared after the update on 2022/10/24 (Mon) 12:00.

■ Special Daily Live
A limited-time Special Daily Live may be held.
You can challenge it by consuming FREE Passes earned each day at 00:00 or Special Passes.
Special Passes you hold do not disappear after the event period ends.
data.help_category-help-live|contents[3].text:
You can challenge by consuming a High Score Pass and earn rewards according to your score.

■ High Score Live Details
You can earn rewards according to your score rank and Mission rewards according to the total score of each Song.
You can also earn rewards by reaching a certain rank in each Song's ranking.

■ Rankings
Rankings compete on the highest score earned for each Song.
Rankings are divided by "Group."
For details on Groups, see "Help > Account > Groups."
data.help_category-help-live|contents[4].text:
Clearing it earns rewards.

■ VENUS Tower Details
You can earn rewards upon first clear.
No items are consumed, and you can challenge as many times as you like.
Clearing it lets you challenge the next stage.
Stages you have cleared once cannot be challenged again.

■ Rankings
You can check the ranking by reached STAGE within your Group.
data.help_category-help-live|contents[5].text:
You can challenge by consuming Challenge attempts or Battle Passes, and earn rewards according to your VENUS Rate ranking.

■ VENUS Battle Details
You do a Live Battle using a subject Song against another Manager's Unit within your Group, and the earned score decides victory or defeat.
VENUS Battle is held for a set period each "Season," and your rank is decided by your VENUS Rate at the end of the period.
The amount of VENUS Rate you can earn differs according to your opponent's VENUS Rate and the win/loss result.

■ Challenge Rewards
When challenging, you can earn VENUS Rate according to your opponent's Rate and the win/loss result, and you can earn rewards according to your ranking.

■ Rank Rewards
At the end of a Season, in addition to period rewards according to your ranking, VENUS Points also increase or decrease.

■ Challenge Attempts
You have 3 challenge attempts per day, updating at 00:00.
When you run out of challenge attempts, you can spend Battle Passes to challenge up to 3 times per day.
data.help_category-help-live|contents[6].text:
Some Live Skills cause various states and effects.

■ Stat Increases and Decreases
They affect Vocal, Dance, and Visual, changing each value.
They change by up to 20 steps.

■ About Boost Effects
They affect the target stat (Vocal, Dance, Visual), raising each value.
Depending on the number of steps, the Stamina consumed when a Skill activates increases.
They change by up to 20 steps.
Boost Effects can stack with stat increase effects.
The increased Stamina consumption from Boost Effects is not removed by effects such as debuff recovery.

■ About Beat Boost Effects
The Beat's score value increases.
Depending on the number of steps, Stamina is consumed each Beat.
They change by up to 20 steps.
Boost Effects can stack with Beat score increase effects.
The Stamina consumption from Boost Effects is not removed by effects such as debuff recovery.

■ Critical States and Effects
Critical Rate Up: Critical Rate increases.
Critical Coefficient Up: The score bonus when a Critical occurs increases.
They change by up to 20 steps.

■ Stamina States and Effects
Consumed Stamina Down: The Stamina consumed when a Skill activates decreases.
Stamina Consumption Up: The Stamina consumed when a Skill activates increases.
They change by up to 20 steps.

■ Score States and Effects
Score Up: The score you earn increases.
Beat Score Up: The Beat's score increases.
P Skill Score Up: If a P Skill or a Photo's special Skill has a score-earning effect, the earned score increases.
A Skill Score Up: The A Skill's score increases.
SP Skill Score Up: The SP Skill's score increases.
Combo Score Up: The score bonus from combos increases. The higher the combo count, the greater the effect.
The above change by up to 20 steps.
P Skill Score Addition: A score-earning effect is additionally granted to P Skills.
The above changes by up to 30 steps.
A Skill Score Addition: A score-earning effect is additionally granted to A Skills.
The above changes by up to 30 steps.
SP Skill Score Addition: A score-earning effect is additionally granted to SP Skills.
The above changes by up to 30 steps.

■ About Limit Release Effects
An Idol affected by a Limit Release Effect can be changed beyond the maximum step count of the specified Skill.
An effect duration is set, and when it ends, any steps above the cap return to the original maximum step count.

■ About Transcendence Effects
When an Idol affected by a Transcendence Effect has the specified Skill and the Transcendence Effect active at the same time, the effect value becomes higher than the normal step count.

■ Notes on Some Score-Earning Effects
The More Enhancement Effects, the Higher the Effect: There is a limit of up to 9 types for effect increases.
However, an Idol affected by the 【Score Earned - The More Enhancement Effects】 enhancement effect count limit release effect can earn score beyond the above maximum types.
An effect duration is set, and when it ends, types above the cap become invalid and the original maximum of 9 types becomes the cap.
The Higher the Skill Success Rate, the Higher the Effect: There is a limit of up to a 200% success rate for effect increases.

■ Attract Attention and Stealth States and Effects
Attract Attention State: Fans of other attending Idols focus on you, and your earned score increases.
Stealth State:
Your own attending Fans focus on other Idols, and the other Idols' earned score increases.
They change by up to 10 steps.

■ About Debuff Reversal
Debuffs at the time of activation are removed and change into the effect corresponding to each effect.
Vocal/Dance/Visual Down -> Changes to Vocal/Dance/Visual Up of the same step.
Stamina Consumption Up -> Changes to Consumed Stamina Down of the same step.
Poor Condition -> CT is reduced by the same amount as the remaining effect duration.

■ Other States and Effects
Combo Continue: The combo continues even in situations where it cannot be continued.
Poor Condition: SP Skills and A Skills can no longer activate.
Debuff Prevention: You no longer receive debuffs that have a fixed Beat count effect. However, immediate effects such as enhancement effect removal or Stamina consumption are not prevented.
Debuff Recovery: Debuffs at the time of activation are removed.
Debuff Reflection: Debuffs received while active are reflected back at the activator.
Tension UP: Changes by up to 10 steps. The scores of A Skills, SP Skills, and P Skills increase, and the success rates of Skills other than P Skills slightly decrease.
Also, by raising Mental excessively for each Live, it is possible to make the Skill success rate 100% even during Tension UP.
Skill Success Rate Up: Changes by up to 10 steps. The success rates of A Skills and SP Skills increase. Also, in Live Battles it becomes easier to steal the right to activate A Skills and SP Skills from your opponent.
Skill Chance Transfer: When you win a Skill chance while in the Skill Chance Transfer state, an Idol with an activatable Skill activates the Skill.
State Change: The target's state changes to another state. Note that even if the target Idol of a state change is in a debuff prevention state, the state change effect still activates.
CT Increase: Increases the CT of the target's Skills that are on CT.
Cover: You take upon yourself debuffs (including immediate effects such as enhancement effect removal or Stamina consumption) that target allies other than yourself.
Seal: P Skills can no longer activate.
Limit Enhancement Steps: Enhancement effects are only exerted up to a step count equal to a specified percentage of the maximum step count.
Enhancement Effect Down: Lowers the step count of all enhancement effects granted. Enhancement effects whose step count reaches 0 from this effect are lost.


■ About the P Skill Effect Range of P Skills and A/SP Skills Activated on the Same Beat
-The calculation of the right to activate A and SP Skills in Live Battles does not take P Skill effects into account.
-For the calculation of earned score, the effects of P Skills activated on the same Beat are taken into account.
※Depending on new activation conditions, Skills that are exceptions may appear.

■ Behavior When One Idol Can Activate Multiple P Skills on the Same Beat
-The same Idol's P Skills cannot activate at the same time; it is one per Beat.
-The activation order is determined by each Skill's own activation conditions, etc.
data.help_category-help-live|contents[7].text:
The Live Analysis feature lets you analyze Lives in more detail than usual.


■ What Is Live Analysis
It is a feature that lets you check details of Score Lives and your opponent's score and parameters in Live Battles.
You can analyze a Live from "Analysis" on the Live Result, Rankings, and other screens.


■ Displayed Information
① Skill Info
You can swipe to move to the next Skill.
At this time, the information shown at the top of the screen is the information of the Idol activating the selected Skill.

② Individual Idol Info
Tapping an Idol thumbnail at the bottom of the screen displays information for the selected lane.
At this time, you can move Beat by Beat with scroll operations.
The information shown at the top of the screen is that lane's Idol information.
Tapping the Idol thumbnail again cancels the lane selection.


■ Screen Details
-"Idol Info"
This is the information shown at the top of the screen.
You can check the Idol's state at that moment.
Tapping each "Current Effect" lets you check information such as the Idol that caused it.

-"Lane Info"
Displays Skill information and such for each lane.

-"P Skill" Button
By checking the "P Skill" button, information other than A and SP Skills is also displayed.

-"Switch Button" (Live Battle only)
In a Live Battle, you can switch between "Self" and "Opponent" information using the button at the bottom of the screen.


■ Other
Information displayed on each screen reflects the state after the displayed Skill or Beat activates.
For Lives played before the feature was added, the Live Analysis feature cannot be used.

At 12:00 on the last day of each month, you earn Diamonds according to your month's activity and Attendance Pt.

data.help_category-help-menu|contents[4].text:
You can interact with other Managers.

■Board
You can create and view threads and post comments.

■Thread
A thread is a message board that users can create on the Board.
Each thread can have up to 500 comments.
Each Manager can create up to 1 thread per day.

■Comment
A comment is a message posted to a thread.

■Pin
You can pin a favorite thread.
You can also display only the threads you have pinned.

■Thread Search
You can search for threads whose title contains a specified string.

■Comment Count and Activity
" ● " indicates a thread's number of comments, and " ▲ " indicates its activity.

■Usage Restrictions
Managers who engage in prohibited conduct, such as inappropriate posts or disruptive behavior, may have their features restricted.
In that case, thread creation and commenting will be unavailable.

<Prohibited Conduct>
- Trolling
- Posts that make third parties uncomfortable
- Slander, defamation, or aggressive posts toward third parties
- Posts of personal information or information that could identify an individual
- Posts offering sales or purchases for profit or non-profit, or similar activity

For each group, you can view detailed information about its Idols.

■Details You Can View
Work Lv
Fans
Core Fan Rate
Trust

■Profile
You can view the profile of the relevant Idol.

■Idol
You can check whether the relevant Idol has been recruited or not.
