data.help_category-help-photo_shooting|conten:
You can consume "Photo Film" to photograph Idols and obtain Photos.

■Photography Details
There are 4 types of photography: Live Photography, Work Photography, Pose Photography, and Story Photography.
A Photo's quality, Rarity, and Options are determined at random.
The higher the Photo Film's Lv, the greater the chance of obtaining a higher-quality Photo.
By "developing" a Photo, the Trust of the Idol used as the subject increases.

■Photography Notes
The Song, stage, Work, or Story content you photograph does not affect the Photo's quality, Rarity, or Options.
The composition of the photographed Photo does not affect the Photo's quality, Rarity, or Options.

■Live Photography
You can photograph the Live scene with the specified members, Song, costumes, hairstyles, and venue to obtain a Photo.

■Work Photography
You can photograph a Work scene (3D) with the specified members, Work, and costumes to obtain a Photo.
When photographing, you can turn Gyro ON to photograph using gyro controls.
Some Works cannot be photographed with certain Idols.

■Pose Photography
You can photograph a Work scene (3D) with the specified members, Work, costumes, and hairstyles to obtain a Photo.
When photographing, you can specify the pose, expression, location, and viewpoint.

■Story Photography
You can photograph stories from the Main Story, Extra Stories, and Idol Stories to obtain Photos.
When developing a Photo photographed from a Story, the target Idol may not match the content of the Photo.
Also, some films, such as the "Guaranteed Exclusive Photo Film" that yields Idol-exclusive Photos, cannot be used in Story Photography. Thank you for your understanding.

■Goods Photography
You can photograph a Goods Case you have customized yourself to obtain a Photo.
The target Idol may not match the content of the Photo.
Also, some films, such as the "Guaranteed Exclusive Photo Film" that yields Idol-exclusive Photos, cannot be used in Goods Photography. Thank you for your understanding.
data.help_category-help-photo|contents[0].tex:
You can view, strengthen, and sell Photos you own.

■Photo Details
Photos take effect when equipped as support for an Idol in Unit Formation.
You can change a Photo's name yourself.
The ownership limit is 600 when not expanded and 1600 when fully expanded; any excess is sent to Gifts.
Some Photos have equippable Idols set for them.

■Photo Quality
A Photo's "Option" effect values differ depending on its quality.
You can consume Advance Film to raise a Photo's quality.
The highest quality obtainable is 175.
The Photo quality cap is planned to be raised in the future.

■Photo ★ (Rarity)
★ (Rarity) ranges from 1 to 5.
The higher the ★ (Rarity), the more likely it is to get Options with higher effect values.

■Selling Photos
By checking "Sell," you can select Photos to sell.
By specifying conditions under "Bulk Condition Selection," you can select Photos in bulk.
Selling Photos earns you Recycling Film.
The higher the quality and Rarity of the Photos you sell, the more Recycling Film you earn.
Photos that are protected or set on your business card cannot be sold.
data.help_category-help-photo|contents[1].tex:
You can consume Recycling Film to reroll a Photo's "Options."

■Reroll Details
All Options are rerolled at random.
Equippable characters are also subject to the reroll's change effects.
The amount of Recycling Film consumed varies depending on the Photo's ★ (Rarity) and quality.

■Reroll Notes
After rerolling, you cannot revert to the original Options.
The Photo's ★ (Rarity) and quality do not change.
Photos with fixed Options cannot be rerolled.
In addition, Photos that already have an Image Training stage generated cannot be rerolled.
data.help_category-help-photo|contents[2].tex:
You can consume Advance Film to raise a Photo's quality.

■Quality Up Details
The effect values of Options already applied increase.
The types of Options do not increase, decrease, or change.
The quality you can raise varies according to your Manager Level.
The maximum quality you can strengthen is 175.
The Photo quality cap is planned to be raised in the future.
Raising the quality of a Retouch Photo requires additional Retouch Ink.
Also, raising the quality of a Photo that already has an Image Training stage generated requires additional Advance Film.
The amount required varies depending on the quality of the material Photos.
Raising quality may increase the number of Image Training stages and their increase values.
However, quality increases from effects within various events do not change the number of Image Training stages or their increase values.
data.help_category-help-photo|contents[3].tex:
You can consume Photo Recipes and Retouch Ink to change a Photo's ★ (Rarity), quality, and Options to the contents of a Photo Recipe.

■Photo Retouch Details
The quality becomes one of the qualities listed in the Photo Recipe.
The Options applied after retouching are those shown on the retouch screen.
Effect values differ per applied Option, just as with normal Photos.

■Photo Retouch Notes
After retouching, you cannot revert to the original state.
Photos with fixed Options can also be retouched.
When you reach the Photo Recipe ownership limit, any excess is sent to Gifts.

■Retouch Photo Notes
A Photo that has been retouched becomes a "Retouch Photo," and its Rarity is displayed with green ★.
In Unit Formation, only 1 Retouch Photo can be equipped per Idol.
Raising the quality of a Retouch Photo requires "Retouch Ink" in addition to "Advance Film."
Retouch Photos have fixed Options and cannot be rerolled.
In addition, Photos that already have an Image Training stage generated cannot be retouched.
data.help_category-help-photo|contents[4].tex:
Image Training is event-style content that is always available.
Clearing stages strengthens the effect values of each of a Photo's Options.
Generated stages can be played at any time.


■About Image Training
It can be played from [Home > Event].
Generated stages can be played at any time.
Missions reset every month on the 15th at 12:00,
and "Image Training Manuals" are sent to Gifts.

■Generating a Stage
From the Photos you own, select
- "Base Photo": the Photo to strengthen (★4 or higher)
- "Material Photo": the Photo needed for strengthening (★4 or higher),
and you can generate a stage for the "Base Photo."

Generating a stage consumes "Image Training Manuals."
The amount consumed varies depending on the Base Photo and Material Photos.
The Base Photo and Material Photos must either both be "Normal Photos" or both be "Retouch Photos."
Also, Photos that already have a stage generated are displayed with a pink Rarity ★ frame.

■Challenging a Stage
The effect values of the Base Photo's Options increase according to the progress of the generated stage.
Depending on the Rarity, quality, and Option similarity of the Base and Material Photos, the difficulty GRADE, number of stages, increase values, and growth rate vary.
You can also SKIP certain stages and set up Helpers according to your Main Live progress.

■Resetting a Stage
You can reset a Base Photo from [Image Training > Stage List > Select Photo > Photo Details].
Resetting resets that stage's progress and the increases to each effect value.
Even if you reset, the Image Training Manuals and Material Photos used to generate the stage are not returned.

■Notes
Material Photos used to generate a stage are lost.
Raising the quality of a Photo that already has a stage generated requires additional Advance Film.

The following Photos cannot be used as Material Photos.
- Locked Photos
- Photos used on your business card
- Photos that already have a stage generated

Also, some Photos cannot be used as Base Photos for Image Training.
- K-ON! Collab "Collab Mission Photos"
You can freely display the in-game Goods you have obtained.

■Customize
You can freely display the in-game Goods you have obtained.
The number of Goods you can place may differ depending on the type of case.

You can also set the case's title, comments, BGM, thumbnail, and more.
Hashtags are set automatically according to the Goods placed in the Goods Case.

You can also photograph your Goods Case to obtain Photos.
When developing a Photo photographed in a Goods Case, the target Idol may not match the content of the Photo.
Also, some films, such as the "Guaranteed Exclusive Photo Film" that yields Idol-exclusive Photos, cannot be used in Goods Photography. Thank you for your understanding.

■Goods Shop
You can consume Goods Medals, Diamonds, and other items to obtain Goods of your choice.
In-game Goods can be obtained in duplicate, and you can place as many as you own in your Goods Case.
However, you can only own 1 of each Figure, Case, and BGM.

■Gallery
You can view and like Goods Cases that other Managers have made public.
You cannot photograph other Managers' Goods Cases.

Also, if you have a "Heart Gift" and like another Manager's Goods Case, you can earn Friend Medals.
The Heart Gift ownership limit is 30, and it recovers by 3 each day.
If you do not have a Heart Gift, liking will not earn you Friend Medals.

Furthermore, when another Manager likes your case, you can earn Friend Medals on your first login of the next day or later.
The maximum number of Friend Medals you can earn at that time is 10.

Note that a like you have given cannot be undone.
Likes you have given reset on the 1st of each month, allowing you to like the same case again.
You can organize recruited Idols, Photos, and Accessories.

■Unit Formation
A Unit that performs a Live is formed of 1 group of 5 members.
You can freely name a Unit you have formed.
You can include Idols with the same name, but in the Live footage another Idol will appear in their place.
Unit Power is calculated from the organized Idols, Photos, and Accessories plus the "Staff Training" values.
For details on Staff Training, see "Help > VENUS Union > Staff Training."
If you swap out an Idol in your formation, the Photos and Accessories equipped to the Idol before the swap are applied as-is to the Idol after the swap.

■Auto
With Auto, Idols, Photos, and Accessories are automatically organized in order of highest stats.
When challenging a Live, auto-formation is performed according to the "tendency" of the Song lanes in that Live, the presence of SP Skills, and A Skill CTs.
When auto-forming, you can specify whether to "Change" or "Lock" the Idols to place.
If "Lock" is selected, only Photos and Accessories are auto-organized.
You can specify which stat tendency to prioritize: Vocal, Dance, or Visual.

■Support Settings
You can equip Photos and Accessories as "Support" for each Idol.
The effects of the equipped Photos and Accessories apply to the Idol placed in that slot.
The number of Photos you can equip differs according to the Lv of the Idol placed in that slot.
"Remove All" lets you remove all set Photos and Accessories at once.

■Placement
You can rearrange Idol placement by dragging.
The Photos, Accessories, and costumes equipped to each formation slot move along with them.

■Costume & Hairstyle
The favorite costumes and hairstyles set under "Dress Up" are automatically applied to your formation.
You can change the costumes and hairstyles worn during a Live individually for each Unit.

■Copy, Overwrite, Delete
You can copy, overwrite, and delete on a per-Unit basis.

■Remove All Support
You can remove all Photos and Accessories in your formation.
You can view and strengthen the Idols you have recruited.

■Idol Types
{0}

Each Idol has a type, and there are 3 kinds: Scorer, Buffer, and Supporter.
Scorer type: A role that earns most of the score through SP Skills and A Skills.
Buffer type: A role that earns score through A Skills and strengthens Idols' abilities.
Supporter type: A role that strengthens other Idols' score gain and restores Stamina.

■Idol Stats
Idols have 4 stats: Vocal, Dance, Visual, and Stamina.
The details of each stat are as follows.
Vocal, Dance, Visual: These affect the score you can earn from SP Skills, A Skills, and Beats according to the Song lane tendencies.
Stamina: This affects whether Skills can be activated; if it runs out during a Live, you can no longer activate Skills.

■Mental and Critical
Mental and Critical are stats that change according to your equipped Photos, Accessories, and Staff Training, regardless of an Idol's Lv or ★ (Rarity).
The details of each stat are as follows.
Mental: This affects the success rate of SP Skills and A Skills.
Critical: This affects the Critical rate for SP Skills, A Skills, and Beats. When a Critical occurs, the score earned increases.

■Story, Messages, Phone
For some Idols, you can view their stories and enjoy messages and phone calls.
For details, see "Help > Messages and Phone."

■Level Up
You can consume Lesson Pieces to raise an Idol's Lv.
Depending on an Idol's Lv, you gain stat increases, learn Skills and Yells, unlock Skill and Yell strengthening, unlock Stories, and unlock Photo slots.
An Idol's Lv cap is determined by your Manager Lv and the Idol's ★ (Rarity).
Live Skills have effects that give you an advantage in Lives.

■Live Skill Details
There are 3 types of Live Skills: Special Skill (SP Skill), Appeal Skill (A Skill), and Passive Skill (P Skill).
SP Skill: Activates at the "SP Skill Chance" set on a Song lane.
A Skill: Activates at the "Skill Chance" set on a Song lane.
P Skill: Activates when specific conditions are met.
Live Skills can be strengthened once an Idol's Lv reaches a specified Lv.

■Live Skill CT (Cooldown)
This refers to the time after a Skill activates until it can be activated again.
For Live Skill effects, see "Live > Live Skill Status and Effects."
■Yell Details
The Yells of all Idols you have recruited are applied in Lives and Work.
Yells can be strengthened once an Idol's Lv reaches a specified Lv.
Collecting Bloom Pt raises an Idol's ★ (Rarity).

■Talent Bloom Details
An Idol that undergoes Talent Bloom has its ★ (Rarity) raised by 1 stage, and its Lv cap and stats increase.
When an Idol of ★ (Rarity) 1-4 reaches ★ (Rarity) 5, the Idol's illustration changes.
For Idols whose illustration has changed, you can switch back to the pre-change illustration from each Idol's details.

■How to Perform Talent Bloom
You can perform Talent Bloom in the following ways.

Obtain an Idol with the same name:
When an Idol with the same name is recruited, you can earn that Idol's Bloom Pt.
When Bloom Pt reaches the required amount, Talent Bloom is performed automatically.

Use Bloom Pieces:
You can consume Bloom Pieces to perform Talent Bloom on any Idol.
The number of Bloom Pieces required differs depending on the remaining Bloom Pt needed for Talent Bloom.

■Where to Obtain Bloom Pieces
Bloom Pieces can mainly be obtained from the "VENUS Tower" and the "Idol Medal Exchange."
By matching the Lv of the top 5 Idols you have recruited, you can raise the Lv of other Idols.

■Level Assist Details
The top 5 Idols by Lv among those you have recruited automatically become "Trainers."
The "Assist Lv" is updated to the lowest Lv among the 5 Trainers.
Idols set as Level Assist targets become the same Lv as the Assist Lv, regardless of their maximum Lv per ★.
If you remove an Idol from the Level Assist targets, its Lv returns to its original value.

■Assist Slots
These are slots that can be set as Level Assist targets.
Assist Slots can be unlocked with "Level Assist Pt" or Diamonds.
An Idol set as a Level Assist target cannot level up until it is removed from the targets.
After setting Level Assist, you cannot remove it from the Assist Slots for 12 hours.

■Assist Lv
Once the Assist Lv is updated, it never decreases.
Even if you "Renew Contract" a Trainer, the Assist Lv is not updated.
The Assist Lv also has a limit and will not exceed its maximum value.
For details on Renew Contract, see "Help > Training > Renew Contract."
You can reset the Lv, each Skill Lv, Yell Lv, and Potential Rank of Idols you have recruited, and recover strengthening materials.

■Renew Contract Details
An Idol's Lv, each Skill Lv, Yell Lv, and Potential Rank are reset, and all materials used for strengthening are returned.
Because ★ (Rarity) is not reset, Bloom Pt and Bloom Pieces are not returned.
Renew Contract consumes Diamonds.

■Formation Notes After Renew Contract
Even if the number of Photo slots decreases because an Idol's Lv returns to 1, Photos already equipped remain equipped, but their effects no longer apply.
You cannot update the formation unless you remove Photos whose effects no longer apply.
Potential Pieces allow you to raise an Idol's Potential Rank.
An Idol's actual Lv cap is the combined value of its ★ (Rarity) and Potential Rank.

■Potential Strengthening Details
An Idol that undergoes Potential Strengthening has its Potential Rank raised by 1 stage, and its Lv cap increases.

■How to Perform Potential Strengthening
You can perform Potential Strengthening in the following ways.

Use Potential Pieces:
You can consume Potential Pieces to perform Potential Strengthening on any Idol.
The number of Potential Pieces required differs depending on the Potential Rank.

■Where to Obtain Potential Pieces
Potential Pieces can mainly be obtained from the "League Medal Exchange" and elsewhere.
data.help_category-help-union|contents[0].tex:
You can belong to 1 of 8 Unions.

■Union Details
There are 8 Unions within each Group.
All Managers can belong to any 1 of the 8 Unions.
Events such as "Union Live," in which Unions compete against each other, are held.

■Check-In
By checking in once per day, you can earn "Union Medals."
Check-in is completed simply by displaying the VENUS Union screen.
Check-in resets every day at 00:00.

■Union Transfer
Outside of the "Union Live" season period, you can transfer Unions at any time.
Union Medals earned and Lvs strengthened through "Staff Training" carry over even if you transfer.
data.help_category-help-union|contents[1].tex:
Unions compete against each other, and you can earn rewards according to your rank.

■Union Live Details
This is a round-robin tournament among all 8 Unions.
It is held over 1 season of 7 days, and each day you face 1 Union to decide a win or loss.
The Union you face resets at 00:00.
Of the matches that Managers of your Union play that day, the total of each Manager's best score becomes that Union's score, and the Union with the higher total score wins.
So that differences in the number of members between Unions do not greatly affect the outcome, the Union total score is adjusted each match according to the login status of its Managers.

■Challenges and Rewards
In Union Live, you earn "Live Points" according to your Live score and win/loss.
Your highest "Live Points" in a day's match becomes your best score.
You can challenge once per day for free, and you can earn match rewards on your first match and victory rewards on your first win.
If you want to aim for updating your best score, you can retry by consuming Diamonds or a High Score Pass.

■Opponents
A Manager of equivalent level is selected by lottery from the opposing Union.
You can choose your opponent from the 3 people shown in the list.

■How Season Ranking Is Determined
At the end of the season, ranking is determined by the number of wins and losses over the 7 matches.
If win counts are equal, the Union with the higher season cumulative score ranks higher.

■Union Record
You can view the ranking and win/loss record of all Unions for that season.

■In-Union Ranking
Ranking is determined by the season cumulative best score of Managers within your Union.
At the end of the season, you can earn rewards according to your rank.
data.help_category-help-union|contents[2].tex:
You can consume Union Medals to strengthen each stat.

■Staff Training
Strengthened stats apply to all Idols you have recruited.
The stats that can be strengthened are Vocal, Dance, Visual, Mental, Stamina, and Critical.

■Number of Strengthenings
The amount of Union Medals consumed differs for each stat according to its number of strengthenings.
The amount of Union Medals earned at check-in increases according to your total number of strengthenings.

■Lv Reset
You can reset the allocation of Staff levels.
If you reset, the materials used for training are returned.
You can reset up to 2 times per month, and the number of available resets updates on the 1st of each month at 0:00.
The 1st reset each month is free, and the 2nd can be done for 50 Red Diamonds and Blue Diamonds.
*The total strengthening count counts from after the reset to the present and does not include strengthenings from before the previous reset.
*For Missions related to the number of Staff Training times, progress does not advance until the post-reset value exceeds the pre-reset value.
data.help_category-help-union|contents[3].tex:
Staff Risers allow you to raise the Potential Rank of Staff Training.
The Staff Training Lv cap increases according to its Potential Rank.

■Staff Training Potential Strengthening Details
When you perform Potential Strengthening on any Staff Training, that Staff Training's Potential Rank is raised by 1 stage, and its Lv cap increases.

■How to Perform Potential Strengthening
You can perform Potential Strengthening in the following ways.
Use Staff Risers:
You can consume Staff Risers to perform Potential Strengthening on any Staff Training.
The number of Staff Risers required differs depending on the Potential Rank.

■Where to Obtain Staff Risers
Staff Risers can mainly be obtained from "Office Rank" and elsewhere.
data.help_category-help-venus|contents[0].tex:
You can view your rank and placement based on your cumulative "VENUS Points."

■VENUS Program Details
You can earn "VENUS Points" according to your results in various Lives, and your cumulative points determine your VENUS RANK and your placement within your Group.
Your VENUS RANK rises when you exceed the specified cumulative points. For higher VENUS RANKs, your placement within the Group is also a requirement.

■VENUS Rank Placement Restrictions
For certain VENUS RANKs and above, in addition to VENUS Points, being within a specified placement is a condition for promotion.
Also, if you fall below the specified placement, your VENUS RANK is demoted.

BIG4: Within 4th place
DIAMOND: Within 1000th place
PLATINUM: Within 2000th place

■Earning VENUS Points
VENUS Points can be earned from Main Live, VENUS Tower, VENUS Battle (season rewards), and Union Live (season rewards).

In VENUS Battle (season rewards) and Union Live (season rewards), points may decrease depending on the final result.

■First to Reach
Within a Group, the Manager who reaches each VENUS RANK first is recorded as the first to reach it, and as a celebration all Managers in the Group can earn rewards.
For details on Groups, see "Help > Account > Group."

■Rewards
You can earn rewards when your VENUS RANK rises.
data.help_category-tips-accessory|contents[0]:
Here you can view, combine, sell, and limit break your Accessories.

■ Accessory Details
They take effect when equipped to support an Idol in Unit formation.
Accessory slots are divided into "Main" and "Sub," and you can equip one of each.
Accessories currently equipped in a Unit are not shown in the Accessory list.

■ Main and Sub
Main: Equip Accessories related to an Idol's Vocal, Dance, and Visual.
Sub: Equip Accessories related to an Idol's Stamina, Mental, and Critical.
data.help_category-tips-accessory|contents[1]:
Combining Accessories lets you obtain more powerful Accessories.

■ Accessory Combining Details
You can combine Accessories with lower effects as materials to create higher ones.
Basically, three of the same Accessory can be combined into one Accessory with an effect one step higher.
For Accessories that have enough materials and Coins, the total number of materials is displayed and they can be combined.


■ Accessory Combining Targets
The Accessories to be used in Accessory combining can be set at the time of combining.

-"Standard"
Combines without including Accessories currently equipped.

-"Excluding VENUS League"
Combines all Accessories not currently equipped in VENUS League.
Note that combined Accessories are removed from your formation.

-"All"
Combines all Accessories.
Note that if you combine Accessories equipped in VENUS League during a VENUS League match, it may affect the VENUS League results.


■ Accessory Combining Notes
The Coins required for combining differ by step.
Accessories equipped in a Unit do not appear in the Accessory combining list and are excluded from combining.
data.help_category-tips-accessory|contents[2]:
You can sell Accessories you own to earn Coins.
Accessories currently equipped are excluded from selling.
data.help_category-tips-accessory|contents[3]:
Limit breaking an Accessory at its final step further increases its effect.

■ Accessory Limit Break Details
Accessories at their final step can be limit broken using Spirit Risers and Coins.
For Accessories that can be limit broken, including those equipped, the total number of items to be used is displayed and they can be limit broken.
A limit break value is shown in the upper-left of limit broken Accessories.
Accessory limit breaks have a maximum value.

■ Accessory Limit Break Notes
The items and Coins required for a limit break differ by step.
After a limit break, you cannot return to the state before it.
Accessory limit breaks become available after clearing Main Live #83.
data.help_category-tips-account|contents[0].t:
You can share data and play across multiple devices.

■ Account Linking
You can link this service's game data between devices that have performed Account Linking.
Each account can link only one set of game data.
If the linked account already has game data, the data you are currently playing will be overwritten.

■ Link Password
You can link by setting a password.
On the destination device, you must enter your Manager ID and the password you set.

■ Account Linking Notes
Blue Diamonds purchased in the app cannot be shared between devices with different OSes.
Blue Diamonds purchased from the Web Shop can be shared between devices with different OSes.
data.help_category-tips-account|contents[1].t:
All Managers are assigned to a "Group" based on their start time and numbers.

■ Moving Groups
Using the average Manager Lv of the Group you first joined as a baseline, you can move if the destination Group's average Manager Lv is higher.
If you meet the conditions, you can move Groups at any time.
Moving Groups changes Union, Ranking, and VENUS Program elements.

■ Notes on Unions
You will belong to the Union of the destination Group.
You will automatically join the Union with the same name as your current Union.
Union Medals carry over to the destination Group.
Staff Training Lv carries over to the destination Group.
All Union Live earned Pt is reset, and your Union ranking starts from the bottom.

■ Notes on Rankings
You will participate in the destination Group's rankings for the following:
Fan Event
High Score Live
VENUS Battle
Union Live
Your previous rank and score are all reset.
Your profile's all-time best rank inherits your current best rank.

■ Notes on the VENUS Program
After moving Groups, reflection is suspended for 14 days, and you are excluded from the rankings and from being the fastest VENUS Rank achiever.
VENUS Points you hold in your current Group carry over as is.
Achiever rewards you have already received cannot be received again.
VENUS Points are still gained and lost during the suspension.
data.help_category-tips-account|contents[2].t:
You can delete your play data without uninstalling the app.
After a data reset, you start from the tutorial.
Note that data cannot be restored.
There are 3 types of Work: Fan Event, Promotion, and Refresh.
Work progresses over time even while you are not playing the game.
Also, depending on the type of Work, you can earn various rewards.
Each Idol has a Work Lv, which rises by doing Work.
When Work Lv rises, the maximum Vigor increases.
Also, the Work Lv cap is unlocked through Main Live progress.
"Fan Event" and "Promotion" continue until Vigor reaches zero.
You can recover "Vigor" through the passage of time or with "Refresh."
Recovery over time restores 1 point every 30 seconds.
While Work is in progress, or while you have not completed your Work, "Vigor" does not recover.
The number of fans attending a Live is determined by "Fans" and "Core Fan Rate."
Depending on the number of attending fans, your score, SP Skill success rate, and A Skill success rate increase.

■Fans
This represents the number of fans cheering for an Idol.
The more Fans, the more fans attend the Live.
"Fans" can be increased through "Promotion."

■Core Fan Rate
This represents the proportion of fans who attend.
The higher the Core Fan Rate, the more of an Idol's fans attend the Live.
"Core Fan Rate" can be increased through "Fan Event."
When selecting the Idol to perform Work, you can change their costume and hairstyle.
The costumes and hairstyles you can select differ depending on the Work content, and for some Work you may not be able to select a costume or hairstyle.
When the Fan Event ends, your Core Fan Rate increases according to "Fan Satisfaction," and you can earn rewards.
You can gain fans according to the passage of time and earn rewards.
You can recover an Idol's Vigor according to the passage of time.
data.help_category-tips-card_reset|contents[0:
An Idol's Lv, each Skill Lv, Yell Lv, and Potential Rank are reset, and all materials used for strengthening are returned.
If you Renew Contract while an Awakening Skill is unlocked, it remains unlocked at Awakening Skill Lv 1.
Because ★ (Rarity) is not reset, Bloom Pt and Bloom Pieces are not returned.

Renew Contract consumes Diamonds.
data.help_category-tips-card_reset|contents[1:
Even if the number of Photo slots decreases because an Idol's Lv returns to 1, Photos already equipped remain equipped, but their effects no longer apply.
You cannot update the formation unless you remove Photos whose effects no longer apply.
data.help_category-tips-card_support|contents:
The top 5 Idols by Lv among those you have recruited automatically become "Trainers."
The "Assist Lv" is updated to the lowest Lv among the 5 Trainers.
Idols set as Level Assist targets become the same Lv as the Assist Lv, regardless of their maximum Lv per ★.
If you remove an Idol from the Level Assist targets, its Lv returns to its original value.

These are slots that can be set as Level Assist targets.
Assist Slots can be unlocked with "Level Assist Pt" or Diamonds.
An Idol set as a Level Assist target cannot level up until it is removed from the targets.
After setting Level Assist, you cannot remove it from the Assist Slots for 12 hours.

Once the Assist Lv is updated, it never decreases.
Even if you "Renew Contract" a Trainer, the Assist Lv is not updated.
The Assist Lv also has a limit and will not exceed its maximum value.
data.help_category-tips-character|contents[0]:
For each group, you can view detailed information about its Idols.

■Details You Can View
Work Lv
Fans
Core Fan Rate
Trust

■Profile
You can view the profile of the relevant Idol.

■Idol
You can check whether the relevant Idol has been recruited or not.

■Song Play Bonus
By performing Lives of each Song with the target character, EXP accumulates, and reaching the specified EXP raises the Song Play Bonus Lv.
You can earn rewards each time the Song Play Bonus Lv increases.

■Photo
You can view the Photos that Idol can equip.
However, Photos whose equippable Idols are Everyone are not displayed.
data.help_category-tips-company|contents[0].t:
You can view your Office Point rank and placement.

■Office Rank Details
Your Office Rank rises when your "Office Points" exceed the specified cumulative points.
"Office Points" are the total of "Interaction Pt," "Achievement Pt," and "Attendance Pt."

■Rewards
You can earn rewards when your Office Rank rises.

■Ranking
From the Ranking, you can view your placement within your Group based on Office Rank.
data.help_category-tips-contest_live|contents:
You can earn rewards by reaching a certain placement.
Also, you can earn additional rewards by achieving a high Score Rank.
Challenging requires a "High Score Pass."

The ranking competes on the placement of your maximum score for each Song.
Rankings are divided by "Group."

You can set an Idol of a Manager you have exchanged business cards with as a Helper and challenge Lives.
Managers who assist as Helpers can earn Friend Medals.
- If a Helper Idol's level exceeds the level cap of your own Idol, its level will be adjusted
- Helper Requests can only be used in "Main Live," "VENUS Tower," "High Score Live," "Link Event," and "Image Training"
- Some Managers who are not friends are also shown in the list
- The Helper Idol list is updated by performing Lives
- Cooperation rewards can be earned for up to 5 people per day, excluding days when you did not log in
- Helper Idols do not gain "EXP," "reward fan increases," or "Song proficiency increases"
data.help_category-tips-contest|contents[0].t:
Photos taken in Event Photography can be submitted to submission destinations.
Photographed photos are given Evaluation Pt.

Evaluation is determined by the photo's quality based on the
- Scene
- Size
- Line of sight
- Position
of the Idol shown, as well as by

- Whether the Idol and costume suit the situation
- Whether the submission destination's requests are met

and other such points.
data.help_category-tips-contest|contents[1].t:
Submitting photos requires an "Event Photography Pass."
Event Photography Passes are granted 5 at a time every day at 0:00 during the event period.

Also, during the event period, they can be obtained with a certain probability from "Fan Event" and "Promotion."


Event Photos you have taken can be developed into equippable-item Photos by using "Event Development Film."
The higher your Manager Lv, the higher the quality of the Photo you can obtain.

Also, photos submitted to the Photo Audition may rarely receive "★4 or Higher Guaranteed" or "★5 Guaranteed" marks.
Developing a photo with a guaranteed mark lets you obtain a "★4 or Higher Guaranteed" or "★5 Guaranteed" Photo.
The "★4 or Higher Guaranteed" and "★5 Guaranteed" marks disappear once developed.
The "★4 or Higher Guaranteed" and "★5 Guaranteed" marks may be attached to photos with a high Evaluation Rank.

Note that Event Photography Passes and Event Development Film are automatically sold after the event ends.
data.help_category-tips-contest|contents[2].t:
There are 3 submission destinations in total, and each has its own requests.
By submitting a photo that meets the requests, you can earn high Evaluation Pt.

Evaluation Pt accumulates for each submission destination, and you can earn rewards when you reach the specified Pt.
data.help_category-tips-contest|contents[3].t:
The photo with the highest Evaluation Pt for each submission destination becomes your "Best Shot."
You compete for ranking based on the total Best Shot Pt across the 3 submission destinations.
You can earn rewards according to your total Best Shot Pt ranking at the end of the event.
data.help_category-tips-contest|contents[4].t:
The Best Shot ranking can be viewed after the event period ends.
You can view the placement and Best Shot of the top 100 at the end of the event.
data.help_category-tips-daily_bonus|contents[:
You can receive it once per day.
It resets every day at 00:00.
On login, your cumulative login days are counted.

Depending on the Lives and Work you performed through the previous day, you can receive a Photo once per day.
The Photo Report resets every day at 00:00.
If you did not perform a Live or Work the previous day, you may not be able to receive a Photo.
The quality of the Photo you receive differs according to your Manager Lv.
If you do not receive it and 00:00 passes, the previous day's Photo Report is lost.
data.help_category-tips-daily_live|contents[0:
Daily Live has 3 types of Lives that let you obtain Coins, Lesson Pieces, and Photo Film.
You can challenge them by consuming Coin Passes, Lesson Passes, and Film Passes respectively, and earn rewards by clearing them.
Also, you can earn additional rewards by achieving a high Score Rank.
For each Live, rewards differ according to difficulty.
Every day at 00:00, you can obtain 5 FREE Passes for each Live.
If you fail to clear it, the Pass is not consumed.

For the bulk play using FREE Passes, the highest difficulty of the Daily Live you have already cleared is run with the formation from your last play.
Please note that only Lives cleared after the 2022/10/24 (Mon) 12:00 update are eligible for bulk play.

Also, a Special Daily Live may be held for a limited time.
You can challenge it by consuming the FREE Passes obtainable every day at 00:00 or Special Passes.
Even after the event period ends, Special Passes you own are not lost.
data.help_category-tips-deck|contents[0].text:
A Unit that performs a Live is formed of 1 group of 5 members.
You can freely name a Unit you have formed.
You can include Idols with the same name, but in the Live footage another Idol will appear in their place.
Unit Power is calculated from the organized Idols, Photos, and Accessories plus the "Staff Training" values.
If you swap out an Idol in your formation, the Photos and Accessories equipped to the Idol before the swap are applied as-is to the Idol after the swap.
data.help_category-tips-deck|contents[1].text:
With Auto, Idols, Photos, and Accessories are automatically organized in order of highest stats.
When challenging a Live, auto-formation is performed according to the "tendency" of the Song lanes in that Live, the presence of SP Skills, and A Skill CTs.
When auto-forming, you can specify whether to "Change" or "Lock" the Idols to place.
If "Lock" is selected, only Photos and Accessories are auto-organized.
You can specify which stat tendency to prioritize: Vocal, Dance, or Visual.
data.help_category-tips-deck|contents[2].text:
You can equip Photos and Accessories as "Support" for each Idol.
The effects of the equipped Photos and Accessories apply to the Idol placed in that slot.
The number of Photos you can equip differs according to the Lv of the Idol placed in that slot.
"Remove All" lets you remove all set Photos and Accessories at once.
data.help_category-tips-deck|contents[3].text:
You can rearrange Idol placement by dragging.
The Photos, Accessories, costumes, and hairstyles equipped to each formation slot move along with them.
data.help_category-tips-deck|contents[4].text:
The favorite costumes and hairstyles set under "Dress Up" are automatically applied to your formation.
You can change the costumes and hairstyles worn during a Live individually for each Unit.
data.help_category-tips-deck|contents[5].text: You can copy, overwrite, and delete on a per-Unit basis.
data.help_category-tips-dream|contents[0].tex:
Image Training is event-style content that is always available.
Clearing stages strengthens the effect values of each of a Photo's Options.
Generated stages can be played at any time.

Image Training can be played from [Home > Event].
Missions reset every month on the 15th at 12:00, and "Image Training Manuals" are sent to Gifts.
data.help_category-tips-dream|contents[1].tex:
From the Photos you own, select
- "Base Photo": the Photo to strengthen (★4 or higher)
- "Material Photo": the Photo needed for strengthening (★4 or higher),
and you can generate a stage for the "Base Photo."

Generating a stage consumes "Image Training Manuals."
The amount consumed varies depending on the Base Photo and Material Photos.

The Base Photo and Material Photos must either both be "Normal Photos" or both be "Retouch Photos."
Also, Photos that have a stage generated are displayed with a pink Rarity ★ frame.
data.help_category-tips-dream|contents[2].tex:
The effect values of the Base Photo's Options increase according to the progress of the generated stage.
Depending on the Rarity, quality, and Option similarity of the Base and Material Photos, the difficulty GRADE, number of stages, increase values, and growth rate vary.
You can also SKIP certain stages and set up Helpers according to your Main Live progress.
data.help_category-tips-dream|contents[3].tex:
You can reset a Base Photo from [Image Training > Stage List > Select Photo > Photo Details].
Resetting resets that stage's progress and the increases to each effect value.
Even if you reset, the Image Training Manuals and Material Photos used to generate the stage are not returned.
data.help_category-tips-dream|contents[4].tex:
Material Photos used to generate a stage are lost.
Raising the quality of a Photo that already has a stage generated requires additional Advance Film.

The following Photos cannot be used as Material Photos.
- Locked Photos
- Photos used on your business card
- Photos that already have a stage generated

Also, some Photos cannot be used as Base Photos for Image Training.
- K-ON! Collab "Collab Mission Photos"
data.help_category-tips-enjoy|contents[0].tex:
You can view your Interactions with Idols and their Interaction Lv.
■Interaction Details
You can earn "Interaction Pt" for each Idol according to gifts and clearing Missions.
Interaction Pt and Interaction Lv differ for each Idol, and when you exceed the specified cumulative points, the target Idol's Interaction Lv rises.

■Overall Interaction Lv
Your Overall Interaction Lv is determined by the cumulative Interaction Pt of all Idols you have recruited, excluding Memories and Collab Idols.
The Overall Interaction Lv rises when you exceed the specified cumulative points.

■Memories & Collab
Memories and Collab Idols are special Idols from different times or worlds.
You cannot interact with Memories or Collab Idols.
Also, for Memories and Collab Idols, the Interaction Lv changes according to the average Interaction Pt of your recruited Idols.

■Memories
You can view "Interaction Stories," "Idol Stories," and "Conversations."

■Interaction Story
These are stories depicting the daily lives of the Idols.
Interaction Stories are unlocked by raising the Interaction Lv of the Idol who is the subject of the Interaction Story to a certain Lv.
Interaction Stories cannot be photographed with the Story Photography feature.

■Gift
You can raise an Idol's Interaction Pt.
For some gifts, the Interaction Pt gained changes depending on the Idol.

■Mission
Clearing them lets you earn Interaction Pt for the target Idol.

■Interaction Bonus
According to Interaction Lv, you can earn the target Idol's Yell, which is applied in Lives and Work.
When the target Idol reaches a specified Interaction Lv, the Yell is strengthened.

■Rewards
You can earn rewards when Interaction Lv rises.

■Ranking
From the Ranking, you can view your placement within your Group based on the target Idol's Interaction Lv.

■Pose Photography
You can photograph a Work scene (3D) with the specified members, Work, costumes, and hairstyles to obtain a Photo.
When photographing, you can specify the pose, expression, location, and viewpoint.

■Outing
You can go out with an Idol to enjoy their reactions and take photos.
You can exchange Idol Medals for items.
Idol Medals can be earned when an Idol you have already recruited appears.
You can exchange VENUS Medals for items.
VENUS Medals can be earned from VENUS Battle rewards.
You can exchange Common Gacha Pt for items.
Common Gacha Pt is obtained by the automatic exchange of expired Gacha Pt.
You can exchange Mini Event Medals for items.
Mini Event Medals can be earned from regular Tour Lives and Mini Events.
You can exchange Bloom Pt Medals for the Bloom Pt of certain ★5 Idols.
The Bloom Pt of certain ★5 Idols added to Diamond Gacha and certain Situation Illustrations appearing in Premium Gacha are eligible for exchange.
If you own an eligible Idol, its obtainable Bloom Pt is displayed.
You cannot exchange for the Bloom Pt of an Idol that has been fully Talent Bloomed.
"Bloom Pt Medals" obtained before a lineup addition can also be used.
Bloom Pt Medals can also be exchanged for ★5 Guaranteed Gacha Support Tickets.
The exchange lineup may change in the future, but this is currently undecided.
You can exchange Friend Medals for items.
The exchange lineup may change in the future, but this is currently undecided.
You can exchange Premium Photo Medals for items.
The exchange lineup may change in the future, but this is currently undecided.
You can exchange League Medals for items.
League Medals can be earned from VENUS League rewards.
You can exchange Rainbow Retouch Ink for Photo Recipes.
The exchange lineup may change in the future, but this is currently undecided.

■Main Effects of Photo Recipes Exchangeable at the Rainbow Retouch Ink Exchange
*For content other than the effects listed here, please check the Exchange.

①[Scorer] Tension UP Skill
<Scorer type only>
When self is on the Vocal lane, apply 5 stages of Tension UP to self [34 Beats]
Consumes 816 Stamina CT:60
*Effect at Lv 2

②[Scorer] Critical Skill
<Scorer type only>
When self is on the Dance lane, apply 7 stages of Critical Coefficient increase to self [40 Beats]
Consumes 855 Stamina CT:60
*Effect at Lv 2

A round-robin tournament among all 8 Unions.
One season lasts 7 days, with one Union matched per day to determine win or loss.
The Union you face is updated at 00:00.
For the matches that members of your Union play that day, the sum of each member's best score becomes your Union's score, and the Union with the higher total score wins.
To prevent differences in member count from greatly affecting the outcome, the Union's total score is adjusted each match based on the login status of its members.
In Union Live, you earn "Live Points" based on your Live score and win/loss result. The highest "Live Points" within a day's matches becomes your best score. You can challenge once free per day, earning match rewards on your first match and victory rewards on your first win.
To aim for updating your best score, you can retry by consuming Diamonds or a High Score Pass.
Managers of equivalent level are randomly selected from the opponent Union.
You can choose your opponent from the 3 Managers shown in the list.
At the end of the season, rankings are determined by the total win/loss record over 7 matches.
In case of the same number of wins, the Union with the higher cumulative season score ranks higher.
You can view the rankings and win/loss records of all Unions for that season.
Rankings are determined by the cumulative season best score of Managers in your Union.
At the end of the season, you can earn rewards based on your rank.
You can earn rewards based on your Union's rank at the end of the season.
All members belonging to the Union receive the same reward.
Members who did not participate in Union Live even once during the period are not eligible for rewards.
You can earn rewards based on your rank within your Union at the end of the season.
Individual Ranking rewards do not change based on your Union's rank.

For each Idol, you can set a favorite costume, check owned costumes, change costumes, and change hairstyles.

■ Setting a Favorite Costume
The favorite costume set in Dress Up becomes the costume worn on Home.
Also, the favorite costume is applied automatically during Unit formation.

data.help_category-tips-home|contents[0].text:
You can check an Idol's current "Vigor" and "Work Lv".

■Vigor
"Vigor" is required to perform the Work "Fan Events" and "Promotions".
"Vigor" can be restored over time or with "Refresh".
Recovery over time restores 1 point every 30 seconds.
It does not recover while a Work is in progress or a Work has not been completed.

■Work Lv
Each Idol has a Work Lv, which increases by doing Work.
Increasing Work Lv raises the maximum Vigor.
Also, the Work Lv cap is unlocked by progressing through Main Live.
data.help_category-tips-home|contents[1].text:

■Fan Count

■Core Fan Rate

data.help_category-tips-home|contents[4].text:

data.help_category-tips-idle|contents[0].text:
{0}

Each Idol has a type, and there are 3 types: Scorer, Buffer, and Supporter.
Scorer type: A role that earns most of the score through SP Skills and A Skills.
Buffer type: A role that earns score through A Skills and strengthens Idols' abilities.
Supporter type: A role that enhances other Idols' score gain and restores Stamina.
data.help_category-tips-idle|contents[1].text:
■Idol Stats
Idols have 4 stats: Vocal, Dance, Visual, and Stamina.
Details of each stat are as follows.
Vocal, Dance, Visual: Affect the score obtainable through SP Skills, A Skills, and Beats according to the tendency of the Song lane.
Stamina: Affects whether Skills can be activated; if it runs out during a Live, Skills can no longer be activated.

■Mental and Critical
Mental and Critical are stats that change according to the equipped Photos and Accessories and Staff Training, regardless of an Idol's Lv or ★ (rarity).
Details of each stat are as follows.
Mental: Affects the success rate of SP Skills and A Skills.
Critical: Affects the Critical occurrence rate for SP Skills, A Skills, and Beats. When a Critical occurs, the score obtained increases.
data.help_category-tips-idle|contents[2].text:
You can increase an Idol's Lv by consuming Lesson Pieces.
Depending on the Idol's Lv, the following occur: stat increases, learning Skills and Yells, unlocking Skill and Yell upgrades, unlocking Stories, and unlocking Photo formation slots.
An Idol's Lv cap is determined by the Manager Lv and the Idol's ★ (rarity).
data.help_category-tips-idle|contents[3].text:
Live Skills have effects that give you an advantage in Lives.

■Live Skill Details
There are 3 types of Live Skills: Special Skill (SP Skill), Appeal Skill (A Skill), and Passive Skill (P Skill).
SP Skill: Activates at the "SP Skill Chance" set on a Song lane.
A Skill: Activates at the "Skill Chance" set on a Song lane.
P Skill: Activates when specific conditions are met.
Live Skills can be strengthened once an Idol's Lv reaches a specified Lv.

■Live Skill CT (Cooldown)
This refers to the time after a Skill activates until it can be activated again.
For Live Skill effects, see "Live > Live Skill Status and Effects."
data.help_category-tips-idle|contents[4].text:
The Yells of all recruited Idols are applied in Lives and Work.
Yells can be upgraded when an Idol's Lv reaches the specified Lv.
data.help_category-tips-idle|contents[5].text:
Collecting Bloom Pt raises an Idol's ★ (Rarity).

■Talent Bloom Details
An Idol that undergoes Talent Bloom has its ★ (Rarity) raised by 1 stage, and its Lv cap and stats increase.
When an Idol of ★ (Rarity) 1-4 reaches ★ (Rarity) 5, the Idol's illustration changes.
For Idols whose illustration has changed, you can switch back to the pre-change illustration from each Idol's details.

■How to Perform Talent Bloom
You can perform Talent Bloom in the following ways.

Obtain an Idol with the same name:
When an Idol with the same name is recruited, you can earn that Idol's Bloom Pt.
When Bloom Pt reaches the required amount, Talent Bloom is performed automatically.

Use Bloom Pieces:
You can consume Bloom Pieces to perform Talent Bloom on any Idol.
The number of Bloom Pieces required differs depending on the remaining Bloom Pt needed for Talent Bloom.

■Where to Obtain Bloom Pieces
Bloom Pieces can mainly be obtained from the "VENUS Tower" and the "Idol Medal Exchange."

data.help_category-tips-league|contents[0].te:
You conduct Live Battles with the units of other Managers in the same league using 2 assigned Songs, and win or loss is decided by the score obtained.
You earn 100 Rate Pt per Live Battle win.
One season lasts 1 week, and at the end of the period rankings are determined by the Rate Pt earned.
Based on your rank, you are promoted, remain, or demoted in the league.

■Matches
Matches are automatically held every day between 12:00 and 15:00, and results can be viewed from 15:00.
Note that if there are changes to your formation Idols, Accessories, or Photos themselves between 12:00 and 15:00, they may affect that day's matches.
Your daily opponents are the 3 Managers with the closest Rate Pt at the start of the match, and you battle each of them with your pre-set units for the 2 assigned Songs.
Since Live Battles are conducted per Manager, your own match results are not included in your opponent's record.

Note that after the season starts, no matches are held until you set your formation.
For daily matches, you must have units set for the 2 assigned Songs by the Live start time, and you must check in to the VENUS League between "15:00 the previous day and 11:59 the current day".
Be sure to check in to the VENUS League every day without fail.
Note that you cannot check in to the VENUS League during the daily match period.

■Formation
For the 2 assigned Songs set for each season, you must set a formation for each.
Even after deciding a formation, you can change it at any time while the season is running.

■Season Rewards
After the season ends, you can earn "League Medals" according to your current league.
You can also earn rewards upon your first promotion to each league.
League Medals can be exchanged for items at the "League Medal Exchange".

data.help_category-tips-live|contents[0].text:
You earn score through the Beats and Skill Chances set for a Song, and clearing the Live requires reaching the target score.
Some Lives have a score rank, and clearing requires obtaining a score of C rank or higher.
Clearing a Live earns you rewards.

■Venue Seats
Represents the maximum number of attending fans.

■Attending Fans
You can check the number of attending fans and its breakdown.
The number of attending fans is determined by Fan Count and Core Fan Rate.
Fan Count: Represents the number of fans of each Idol.
Core Fan Rate: Represents the proportion of fans who attend.
The score, SP Skill success rate, and A Skill success rate increase according to the number of attending fans.

■Target Score
Reaching it clears the Live.

■Song Lv
Represents the difficulty of the Live.

■Song Lane Tendency
Represents the stats that affect the score of A Skills and SP Skills.
Also, the stats that affect everyone's Beat score vary according to the Song's lane tendency.

■Lane Information
You can check the activation frequency and order of Skills.
"SP": Represents whether an SP Skill is placed.
"Few"/"Many": Represents the amount of A Skills placed.

■Live Details
Clear Rewards: Rewards obtainable when clearing the Live.
Live Features: You can check the features set for each Live.
Active Live Yells: You can check the breakdown of Live Yells activated during the Live.
Yell-Activating Idols: You can check the Idols whose Yells are active.
Recent Clear: You can watch or analyze the Live of the Manager who most recently cleared it.

■What You Can Check During a Live
You can check the score obtained from Beats and Skill Chances.
Skills activate in time with the incoming Skill Chances.
The Skill success rate varies according to the Idol's Mental and the Live's required Mental.
When a Critical occurs, you can obtain more score than usual.

■What You Can Check After a Live
You can check the score obtained and its breakdown.
In "Lane Information", you can check whether Skills activated.
In "Replay", you can look back on the Live footage.
In "Analysis", you can analyze the Live in more detail.

■Live Notes
The required Mental and Critical vary depending on the Live.

■Live Skip
By checking "Live Skip", you can skip the Live and watch only the "Highlight".

■Highlight
You can quickly check only the activation results of each Idol's Skills and the score obtained.
By long-pressing the screen, you can view it at double speed.
data.help_category-tips-live|contents[1].text:

data.help_category-tips-live|contents[2].text:
You can challenge by consuming Challenge attempts or Battle Passes, and earn rewards according to your VENUS Rate ranking.

■ VENUS Battle Details
You do a Live Battle using a subject Song against another Manager's Unit within your Group, and the earned score decides victory or defeat.
VENUS Battle is held for a set period each "Season," and your rank is decided by your VENUS Rate at the end of the period.
The amount of VENUS Rate you can earn differs according to your opponent's VENUS Rate and the win/loss result.

■ Challenge Rewards
When challenging, you can earn VENUS Rate according to your opponent's Rate and the win/loss result, and you can earn rewards according to your ranking.

■ Rank Rewards
At the end of a Season, in addition to period rewards according to your ranking, VENUS Points also increase or decrease.

■ Challenge Attempts

When you run out of challenge attempts, you can spend Battle Passes to challenge up to 3 times per day.
data.help_category-tips-live|contents[3].text:

data.help_category-tips-live|contents[5].text:
You can challenge by consuming a High Score Pass, and earn rewards according to your score.

■High Score Live Details
You can earn rewards according to your score rank and Mission rewards according to the total score of each Song.
Also, you can earn rewards by reaching a certain rank in each Song's ranking.

■Ranking
Rankings compete based on the highest score obtained for each Song.
Rankings are divided by "Group".
For details on Groups, see "Help > Account > Group".
data.help_category-tips-live|contents[6].text:
You can spend various Passes to do Lives and earn specified rewards.

■ Daily Live Details
There are three types of Daily Live where you can earn Coins, Lesson Pieces, and Shooting Film.
Each can be challenged by consuming a Coin Pass, Lesson Pass, or Shooting Pass respectively.
Rewards differ by each Live's difficulty.
You can also earn bonus rewards according to your score rank.
If you fail to clear it, the Pass is not consumed.

■ FREE Passes
Every day at 00:00, you earn 5 FREE Passes for each Live.
FREE Passes from the previous day that were unused as of 0:00 are lost.

■ Batch Play for FREE Passes
In Batch Play, the highest difficulty of a cleared Daily Live is executed with the formation from your last play.
Note that Daily Lives eligible for Batch Play are only those cleared after the update on 2022/10/24 (Mon) 12:00.

■ Special Daily Live
A limited-time Special Daily Live may be held.
You can challenge it by consuming FREE Passes earned each day at 00:00 or Special Passes.

data.help_category-tips-main_live|contents[9]:
Let's train and set formations while checking the following.

◇Are you raising your Idols' Lv?
Raising an Idol's Lv increases their stats, allowing you to obtain higher scores.
Don't forget to level up your Idols.
The "Lesson Pieces" needed for leveling up can be obtained from
·Free Training
·Work > Promotion
·Live > Daily Live
·Shop > Market
and more.

When you can't win, waiting a while is also an option.
Just leaving it for a certain time lets you earn rewards such as Lesson Pieces through "Free Training", making you stronger.

◇Are your SP Skills activating?
Every Live has a lane with an SP Skill Chance.
Place an Idol with an SP Skill in the target lane.
SP Skills can earn very high scores.

◇Are your A Skills activating?
The number and frequency of A Skill Chances differ by lane.
Skills have a "CT", and a Skill that has activated once cannot activate again until its "CT" reaches 0.
If a Skill does not activate even though you placed an Idol with an A Skill,
try various things to make Skills activate, such as
·placing an Idol with a short Skill CT
·placing an Idol with 2 A Skills.

◇Are your Mental and Fan Count sufficient?
If Mental or Fan Count is insufficient, the Skill success rate drops and may fail.
Mental can be raised through Sub Accessories and Photos,
and Fan Count by raising Fan Count and Core Fan Rate through Work.

◇Are you placing Idols to match tendencies?
Lives have a tendency for each lane.
The score obtainable at a Vocal-tendency lane's Skill Chance is determined by the Vocal value of the placed Idol.
Matching the lane's tendency with an Idol's strong stats raises the score obtainable through Skills.

The tendencies are as follows.
·Pink: Vocal
·Blue: Dance
·Yellow: Visual

◇Are you synthesizing Accessories?
By consuming 3 identical Accessories and Coins, you can obtain an Accessory with one higher ★ (rarity).
By synthesizing to obtain more powerful Accessories and setting them to match the Live, you can obtain higher scores.
data.help_category-tips-market|contents[0].te:
The item lineup is automatically updated every day at 00:00 and 12:00.
You can also update the lineup yourself from "Refresh".
The maximum number of refreshes is 10, and the first is free.
After that, Diamonds are consumed, and the cost varies with the number of refreshes.
The refresh count resets every day at 00:00 and 12:00.
data.help_category-tips-message|contents[0].t:
You can exchange messages with Idols.
The content of messages changes according to an Idol's "Trust".
Exchanging messages may increase an Idol's Trust.
data.help_category-tips-message|contents[1].t:
You can call Idols.
The content of calls changes according to an Idol's "Trust".
data.help_category-tips-message|contents[2].t:
Messages from Idols arrive even while you are not playing the game.
By turning on push notifications, you can receive a notification when a message arrives.
data.help_category-tips-mission|contents[0].t:
You can check Mission contents and receive completion rewards.

■ Mission Details
You can receive rewards by meeting specified conditions.
Rewards not received before the update are lost even if you completed them.

■ Update Timing
Daily Missions: Contents update every day at 00:00.
Weekly Missions: Contents update every Monday at 00:00.

■ Added Missions and Increased Rewards
Some Daily and Weekly Missions have increased rewards according to Manager Lv at the update timing.
Some Missions are also unlocked according to Manager Lv and Main Live progress.
Between updates, Missions will not be unlocked or have their rewards increased partway through.
data.help_category-tips-photo_retouch|content:
By consuming a Photo Recipe and Retouch Ink, a Photo's ★(Rarity), Quality, and Options are changed to the contents of the Photo Recipe.

■Photo Retouch Details
The Quality applied after retouching has a range and will be one of the values shown on the Retouch screen.
The Options applied after retouching will be the contents shown on the Retouch screen.

■Photo Retouch Notes
After photo retouching, you cannot return to the original state.
Photos with fixed Options, such as Memorial Photos, can also be retouched.
When you reach the upper limit of Photo Recipes held, the excess amount is added to Gifts.

Photos that have undergone Photo Retouch become "Retouch Photos," and their Rarity is displayed with green ★.

■Retouch Photo Notes
In Unit formation, only one Retouch Photo can be equipped per Idol.
When increasing the Quality of a Retouch Photo, "Retouch Ink" is required in addition to "Advance Film."
Retouch Photos have fixed Options and cannot be rerolled.
data.help_category-tips-photo_shooting|conten:
There are 4 types of photography: Live Photography, Job Photography, Pose Photography, and Story Photography.
A Photo's Quality, Rarity, and Options are determined at random.
The higher the Lv of the Photography Film used, the greater the chance of obtaining a high-Quality Photo.
"Developing" a Photo increases the Trust of the Idol who was the subject.
Please note that when developing a Photo taken in Story, the target Idol may not match the content of the Photo.

You can photograph a Live scene with the specified Members, Song, Costume, Hairstyle, and Venue to obtain a Photo.
Some Songs have Venues where photography is not possible.

You can photograph a Job scene (3D) with the specified Members, Job, Costume, and Hairstyle to obtain a Photo.
When photographing, turning Gyro ON lets you photograph using gyro controls.
Some Idols have Jobs where photography is not possible.

Rarity is drawn from among "★1 to ★5."

The Song, Stage, Job, or Story content being photographed does not affect Rarity.
The quality of the resulting Photo does not affect Rarity.

A Photo's Quality varies depending on the "Photography Film" used.
The higher the Lv of the Film, the more you can expect to obtain a high-Quality Photo.

The Song, Stage, Job, or Story content being photographed does not affect the Photo's Quality.
The quality of the resulting Photo does not affect the Photo's Quality.

When developing, the Trust of the Idol shown largest in the Photo increases.
As Trust increases, the content of messages you receive and the conversations on the Home screen change.

You can photograph the Main Story, Extra Story, and Idol Story to obtain Photos.
When developing a Photo taken in Story, the target Idol may not match the content of the Photo.
Please also note that some Films, such as the "Guaranteed Exclusive Photo Film" that obtains an Idol-exclusive Photo, cannot be used in Story Photography.

You can photograph a Job scene (3D) with the specified Members, Job, Costume, and Hairstyle to obtain a Photo.
When photographing, you can specify the Pose, Expression, Location, and Viewpoint.
Some Idols have Jobs where photography is not possible.
There are also Poses that cannot be used with certain Costumes, Hairstyles, or Jobs.
data.help_category-tips-photo|contents[0].tex:
They demonstrate their effect when set to support an Idol in Unit formation.
You can rename Photos yourself.
The holding limit is 600 when unexpanded and 1600 at maximum expansion, and any excess is added to Gifts.
Some Photos have specified Idols that can be placed.
data.help_category-tips-photo|contents[1].tex:
The effect value of a Photo's "Options" differs according to the Photo's quality.
By consuming Advance Film, you can increase a Photo's quality.
data.help_category-tips-photo|contents[2].tex:
★(Rarity) ranges from 1 to 5.
The higher the ★(Rarity), the more likely it is that Options with higher effect values will be attached.
data.help_category-tips-photo|contents[3].tex:
By checking "Sell," you can select the Photos or Photo Recipes to sell.
You can also use "Bulk Condition Search" to specify conditions and select Photos in bulk.

■Selling Photos
Selling Photos earns you Recycling Film.
The amount of Recycling Film you can earn increases with the Quality and Rarity of the Photo you sell.
When selling a Retouch Photo, you can additionally earn Retouch Ink.
The amount of Retouch Ink you can earn increases with the Rarity and Quality of the Photo Recipe most recently used on that Photo.
Photos that are Protected, or set as a Business Card, cannot be sold.

■Selling Photo Recipes
Selling Photo Recipes earns you Retouch Ink.
The amount of Retouch Ink you can earn increases with the Quality and Rarity of the Photo Recipe you sell.
data.help_category-tips-photo|contents[4].tex:
By consuming Recycling Film, you can reroll a Photo's "Options."

■Reroll Details
All Options are rerolled at random.
Characters that can be deployed are also subject to the reroll's changed effects.
The amount of Recycling Film consumed varies depending on the Photo's ★(Rarity) and Quality.

■Reroll Notes
After rerolling, you cannot return to the original Options.
The Photo's ★(Rarity) and Quality do not change.
Photos with fixed Options cannot be rerolled.
data.help_category-tips-photo|contents[5].tex:
By consuming Advance Film, you can increase a Photo's Quality.

■Quality Up Details
The effect values of Options already attached increase.
The types of Options do not increase, decrease, or change.
data.help_category-tips-premium_gacha|content:
By consuming a "Premium Gacha Ticket," you can have Idols join or obtain Items.

■Premium Gacha Details
You can pull the Gacha with a "Premium Gacha Ticket."
The Idols that join and the Items obtained differ depending on the period held.
You can check the history from Gacha History.

■Premium Slot
The Premium Slot is limited-time and is changed after the period ends.
The Premium Slot is guaranteed to appear after pulling the Premium Gacha 200 times.
If the Premium Slot appears within 200 pulls, the count until the Premium Slot is guaranteed is reset.
Even if the Premium Slot is changed, the count until the Premium Slot is guaranteed is not reset.

■Where to Obtain Premium Gacha Tickets
Premium Gacha Tickets can be obtained in the Shop and other places.

You compete in Live Battles with the Units of other Managers in your Group using the designated Song, and the winner is decided by the score obtained.
VENUS Battles are held for a fixed period for each "Season," and rankings are determined by your VENUS Rate at the end of the period.

You can check the Achievement Mission contents and Achievement Lv.

You can earn "Achievement Pt" by clearing Achievement Missions.
When you exceed a specified cumulative point total, your Achievement Lv increases.

data.help_category-tips-union|contents[0].tex:
You belong to one of 8 Unions and can carry out various Union-related activities.

There are 8 Unions within each Group.
All Managers can belong to any one of the 8 Unions.
Events such as "Union Live," where Unions compete against each other, are held.
data.help_category-tips-union|contents[1].tex:
By checking in once per day, you can earn "Union Medals."
Check-in is completed simply by displaying the VENUS Union screen.
Check-in resets every day at 00:00.
data.help_category-tips-union|contents[2].tex:
You can consume Union Medals to strengthen each stat.

■Staff Training
Strengthened stats apply to all Idols you have recruited.
The stats that can be strengthened are Vocal, Dance, Visual, Mental, Stamina, and Critical.

■Number of Strengthenings
The amount of Union Medals consumed differs for each stat according to its number of strengthenings.
The amount of Union Medals earned at check-in increases according to your total number of strengthenings.

■Lv Reset
You can reset the allocation of Staff levels.
If you reset, the materials used for training are returned.
You can reset up to 2 times per month, and the number of available resets updates on the 1st of each month at 0:00.
The 1st reset each month is free, and the 2nd can be done for 50 Red Diamonds and Blue Diamonds.
*The total strengthening count counts from after the reset to the present and does not include strengthenings from before the previous reset.
*For Missions related to the number of Staff Training times, progress does not advance until the post-reset value exceeds the pre-reset value.
data.help_category-tips-union|contents[3].tex:
A round-robin tournament among all 8 Unions.
One season lasts 7 days, with one Union matched per day to determine win or loss.
The Union you face is updated at 00:00.
For the matches that members of your Union play that day, the sum of each member's best score becomes your Union's score, and the Union with the higher total score wins.
To prevent differences in member count from greatly affecting the outcome, the Union's total score is adjusted each match based on the login status of its members.
data.help_category-tips-union|contents[4].tex:
Outside the "Union Live" Season period, you can transfer Unions at any time.
Union Medals earned and Lv enhanced through "Staff Training" are carried over even if you transfer.
data.help_category-tips-union|contents[5].tex:
Staff Risers allow you to raise the Potential Rank of Staff Training.
The Staff Training Lv cap increases according to its Potential Rank.

■Staff Training Potential Strengthening Details
When you perform Potential Strengthening on any Staff Training, that Staff Training's Potential Rank is raised by 1 stage, and its Lv cap increases.

■How to Perform Potential Strengthening
You can perform Potential Strengthening in the following ways.
Use Staff Risers:
You can consume Staff Risers to perform Potential Strengthening on any Staff Training.
The number of Staff Risers required differs depending on the Potential Rank.

■Where to Obtain Staff Risers
Staff Risers can mainly be obtained from "Office Rank" and elsewhere.
data.help_category-tips-venus|contents[0].tex:
You can earn "VENUS Points" according to your results in various Lives, and your cumulative points determine your VENUS RANK and your rank within your Group.
VENUS RANK increases when you exceed a specified cumulative point total. For higher VENUS RANKs, your rank within the Group is also a condition.

■VENUS Rank Rank Restrictions
For a certain VENUS Rank and above, in addition to VENUS Points, being within the specified rank is a promotion condition.
Also, if you fall below the specified rank, your VENUS Rank is demoted.

BIG4: Within 4th place
DIAMOND: Within 1000th place
PLATINUM: Within 2000th place
data.help_category-tips-venus|contents[1].tex:

In VENUS Battle (Season Rewards) and Union Live (Season Rewards), points may decrease depending on the final result.
data.help_category-tips-venus|contents[2].tex: The Manager who reaches each VENUS RANK first within the Group is recorded as the Fastest Achiever, and as a celebration, all Managers in the Group can earn rewards.

data.help_content-help-backside|contents[0].t:
The "Training Camp" has 2 areas: the Rehearsal Area and the Main Area.
Clearing the Rehearsal Area makes it possible to challenge the Main Area, but please note that you cannot challenge the Rehearsal Area again.
Also, the results of the Rehearsal Area do not affect the Main Area.

The Rehearsal Area and Main Area each have 3 Training Stages, and clearing them lets you challenge the Rehearsal and Main performances.
The "Live Bonus" earned in each Training Stage is reflected in the Rehearsal and Main performances.
If you rechallenge a Training Stage and update your record, the Live Bonus reflected in the Rehearsal and Main performances is also updated.

Note that for Special Training Camps, only the Main Area is available.
"Training Camp Stamina" is required to challenge each Main performance stage.
Training Camp Stamina is added 1 at a time every 5 hours from the timing when you can challenge Main stages.
Please note that Training Camp Stamina does not recover while challenging a Rehearsal.
There is no upper limit to the addition of Training Camp Stamina.
Also, Special Training Camps have no Training Camp Stamina.
You can earn "Training Points" each time you clear a Training Stage.
Training Points are the Live Bonus earned in that stage converted into points.
The total Training Points earned across the 3 Training Stages is called "Total Training Points."
Rankings are determined by the best Live Score obtained in the Main performance at the end of the Event period.
You can earn rewards according to your rank.
■Stage Clear Rewards
You can earn rewards upon the first clear of each stage.

■Clear Rank Rewards
You can earn rewards according to the maximum rank achieved when clearing Main stages.
Clear Rank Rewards go up to S+50.

■Training Score Rank Rewards
You can earn rewards according to the maximum Training Rank achieved when clearing each Main Training Stage.
Training Score Rank Rewards go up to S+5.

■Ranking Rewards
You can earn rewards according to the Main Live Score ranking.
Rewards are added to Gifts after the Event ends.
You can view the Event's story.
Stories are unlocked by advancing through stages.
After the Event period ends, all Event Stories are unlocked regardless of condition completion status.
You can check the Event's Mission contents.
By clearing Missions, you can earn rewards.
Event Missions can only be challenged and collected during the Event period.
You can exchange Training Camp Medals for products.
Training Camp Medals and the Exchange Shop have expiration dates.
Training Camp Medals past their expiration date are converted into 300 Coins each.
Training Camp Medals and Exchange Shop
If you move Groups during the Event period, your Main Live Score and ranking are reset.
Each time you play a stage, the stage's Menu layout changes.
data.help_content-help-backside|contents[1].t:
Stages are composed of multiple "Menus," and you progress by executing Menus.
Each stage also has red Menus placed as clear goals.
Clearing those within the limited number of days (turns) clears the stage.
※Names change depending on the stage.

Sugoroku is an event in which you consume Stamina to roll dice and advance across squares.
Advance across the squares while making use of Items, Sugoroku Medals, Sugoroku Coins, and more.
Also, according to the number of squares you advanced that day, you can earn a Daily Bonus on the next day's login.

Additionally, you can earn Event-exclusive Live Bonuses in the various contents within the Event.
Collecting Live Bonuses lets you obtain higher Live Scores.

■Ranking
The last square of an Area has a "Goal Square," and clearing the Live on the Goal Square lets you advance to the next Area.
The Live content of the Goal Square is common to each Area, and you compete for the high score on the Goal Square in a ranking format.
After the Event period ends, you can earn Ranking Rewards according to the ranking.

You can earn Sugoroku Medals.

"Coin Square"
You can earn Sugoroku Coins.

You can earn a specific Live Bonus.

You can advance by the number of squares written on the square.

To advance to the next square, you must clear the Live.
If you fail the Live, you must rechallenge the same Live, and only on the rechallenge do you consume 20 Stamina.

Clearing the Live lets you advance to the next Area.
If you arrive with the exact number of squares, you can earn Sugoroku Medals as an Exact Arrival Bonus.
You cannot advance to the next Area unless you clear the Live, but unlike "Live Squares" and "Battle Squares," no Stamina is required for a rechallenge.
