Multiple Stages exist within the BOX Live of a Solo Live, and by clearing the Live on each Stage, you can earn Links Medals and Unlock Pt.
To attempt a BOX Live, "L Stamina" is required.

■Stage Unlocking
Unlocking a Stage requires "Unlock Pt", and the Unlock Pt needed differs by Stage.
Unlock Pt can be earned by clearing the Live on each Stage of the Link Event.

■BOX Gacha
Some Stages are linked to a "BOX Gacha".
Clearing a BOX Gacha Stage raises the corresponding "BOX Gauge".
When the BOX Gauge reaches its maximum, the corresponding BOX Gacha is unlocked and becomes available for drawing.

■Difficulty Settings
A Difficulty can be selected for each Stage.
The higher the Difficulty, the better the rewards.
Difficulties above a certain level may become available for attempting once you meet the conditions.
If you fail a Live, you cannot earn rewards, but L Stamina is not consumed either.

■Co-op Live Request
This is a Live for which you can request cooperation from other Managers.
When you play the Live, a cooperation request is sent to other Managers regardless of the score earned or clear status, and you can earn Request Rewards.
Cooperation requests to other Managers can only be made once every 6 hours.
A requested Live is valid for 10 hours, and if it is not cleared within the valid time, the Live fails.
Also, the Lv of Co-op Lives you can request is unlocked by clearing No.4 of the BOX Live.

In Co-op Lives, you can attempt cooperation requests from other Managers and check the progress of Lives you have requested or cooperated on in the past.
To attempt a Co-op Live, "K Stamina" is required.
Note that in Co-op Lives, performing the Live skips directly to the Live Result.

■Cooperation Available
A list of Lives for which other Managers have requested cooperation is displayed.
Playing a Live requires "Co-op Stamina (K Stamina)".
The higher the level of the Live you attempt, the more Co-op Stamina is required.

The required Co-op Stamina is discounted when the requesting Manager is your Friend.
Also, when you cooperate with another Manager, you can earn Co-op Rewards at the end of the Live.
The Lives displayed in the Cooperation Available list vary depending on your clear status of No.4 of the Solo Live.
Note that updating the Cooperation Available list takes a certain amount of time.

■In Progress
You can check the progress of Lives you have requested or cooperated on in the past.
A Live you have already played cannot be attempted again.

■Completed
Displayed when a Live you have requested or cooperated on in the past is completed.
When a Co-op Live succeeds, you earn MVP Rewards if you achieved the highest score among the participating Managers, and Clear Rewards even if you did not.
After checking the result of each Live, it is removed from the list and can be viewed via the "History" button.

A Solo Live requires "Links Stamina", and cooperating with another Manager requires "Co-op Stamina".
Each type of Stamina recovers over time.
You can also recover Links Stamina by consuming "Links Candy" and Co-op Stamina by consuming "Co-op Candy".
"Links Candy" and "Co-op Candy" are automatically sold when the Event ends.

This is an item Gacha that can be drawn using "Links Medals".
There are multiple types of BOX Gacha, and the contents offered differ for each BOX.

■Unlocking BOX Gacha
A BOX Gacha is unlocked by maxing out the corresponding "BOX Gauge".
The BOX Gauge is linked to each Stage, and the Gauge rises when you clear the corresponding Stage.

■BOX Drawing
The contents offered by a BOX Gacha each have a stock count.
Items whose stock reaches 0 are no longer offered from the BOX.
Also, items with stock of "∞" will not disappear from the BOX no matter how many you obtain.

You can earn rewards by consuming the "Reward Pt" earned from Events and completing Missions.

After the Event period ends, all Event Stories are unlocked regardless of the achievement status of conditions.

- Race Pt Stage: Race Pt earning efficiency
- Race Medal Stage: Race Medal earning efficiency

The higher the Difficulty you have cleared, the higher the Efficiency Lv.
Also, the Efficiency Lv is reflected in Race Training's earning efficiency at 0:00 every 2 days.
data.help_content-help-race|contents[3].title: Earning Efficiency UP Stage
data.help_content-help-race|contents[4].text:
You can learn and strengthen them by consuming Race Medals.
The Live Bonuses you learn apply their effects to every Live in the VENUS Race during the period.

By using a "Bonus Eraser", you can reset all learned and strengthened Live Bonuses, and the Race Medals you consumed are returned.
data.help_content-help-race|contents[4].title: Live Bonus
data.help_content-help-race|contents[5].text:
At the start of the VENUS Race, you are assigned in groups to a Race Group based on your VENUS Rank at the start, with a certain number of people per group.
In the VENUS Race, your ranking is determined by the number of spaces advanced during the period within the same group.
data.help_content-help-race|contents[5].title: Match Group
data.help_content-help-race|contents[6].text:
Interim results are tallied at 0:00 every 2 days during the period.
You can earn rewards according to your ranking in the interim results.
data.help_content-help-race|contents[6].title: Interim Ranking Rewards
data.help_content-help-shelf|contents[0].text:
You can film, save, and develop the Event Story appearing during that period.

The Photos you film can be saved up to 100, and you must develop them to use them as in-game Photos.

Developing Photos consumes the item "Event Development Film".
When you reach the Photo save limit, you can save new Photos by deleting saved Photos.

Due to the nature of Stories, the person shown in the Photo and the target person at the time of Photo development may rarely not match.
Please understand this in advance.
data.help_content-help-shelf|contents[1].text:
You can use saved Photos to create your own original Album with special designs.
The "number of Photos that can be set" may differ for each Album design.

The completed Album can be developed by consuming the item "Event Development Film".

The target person at the time of Photo development is selected from the target persons of each Photo set in the Album.
data.help_content-help-shelf|contents[2].text:
In the Photo Album, you can develop not only Albums but also Story Photos.
Developing Photos requires the item "Event Development Film", just like Album development.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[0].text:
The Regular Tour can be attempted by reaching Manager Lv40 or higher and clearing Main Live #1.
The Regular Tour can be attempted any number of times during the period, and you can also select the Difficulty to attempt.
The Difficulty can be changed by retiring or clearing.
If you change the Difficulty, you start from Area 1.
Also, if you clear an Area of the Tour, all Difficulties lower than the one you attempted are also counted as cleared, and you can earn the rewards for Difficulties lower than the one you cleared all at once.
The Mini Event Medal Exchange lineup's exchange items change as your Manager Lv increases.
The Mini Event Medal Exchange lineup is scheduled to change periodically.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[0].title: Regular Tour Live
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[1].text:
An Area is composed of multiple "Spaces", and you progress by selecting Spaces.
The final Space contains the "Area Boss Space".
By winning the Live Battle at the Area Boss Space, you can proceed to the next Area.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[1].title: Area
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[2].text:
■Live Space
Clearing the Live lets you earn Live Bonuses.

■SP Live Space
Clearing the Live lets you earn highly effective Live Bonuses.

■Rival Space
By winning the Live Battle against a "Rival", 1 Idol joins.

■Scout Space
The selected Idol joins.
This join is only for the duration of the Tour in progress.

■Refresh Space
You can recover the Stamina of all Idols.

■SP Refresh Space
You can recover more Stamina for all Idols.

■Area Boss Space
Winning results in Area Clear.
You can earn highly effective Live Bonuses.

※Idols who join via Rival Spaces and Scout Spaces remain until the Tour in progress ends.
　The same Idol can newly join even if already joined.
　You cannot form 2 or more of the same Idol in the same Unit.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[2].title: Square
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[3].text:
You can form a Unit from all Idols who have joined.
In Regular Tour Lives, Photos and Accessories cannot be formed.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[3].title: Unit
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[4].text:
During a Tour, Idol Stamina does not recover after a Live ends and carries over the Stamina status from the previous Live's end.
You can recover Stamina via Refresh Spaces and SP Refresh Spaces.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[4].title: Stamina
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[5].text:
Applies to the Unit's Idols in all Tour Lives.
You can earn "Live Bonuses" by clearing Live Spaces, SP Live Spaces, and Area Boss Spaces.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[5].title: Live Bonus
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[6].text:
You can attempt again even if you fail each Live.
However, the Idol Stamina consumed carries over as is.
Also, if you are defeated at a Rival Space, you proceed to the next Space without the Rival joining.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[6].title: Live Failure
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[7].text: Regular Tour Lives do not have a Ranking.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[7].title: Ranking
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[8].text:
You can exchange Mini Event Medals for items.
At the Mini Event Medal Exchange, you can still exchange after the Regular Tour Live ends.
The lineup is added to according to your Manager Lv.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[8].title: Mini Event Medal Exchange
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[9].text: Every time you play a Regular Tour Live, the Space layout of the Area changes.
data.help_content-help-tour|contents[9].title: Notes
data.help_content-tips-invite|contents[0].tex:
A Manager who has started the game enters an Invitation Code to become an "Invited Friend".
※Invited Friends differ from regular Friends.

You can invite up to 20 people.

◆Eligibility for Invitation
- Managers within 30 days of starting the game
- Managers whose last login was 30 or more days ago

※Invitation becomes possible after clearing Main Live #7
data.help_content-tips-invite|contents[1].tex:
When an Invited Friend progresses through Main Lives, the inviting side can earn Friend Medals as rewards.

The progress rewards have a limit, and once the limit is reached, no further rewards can be earned.
Also, if an Invited Friend does not log in for 30 or more days, the Invited Friend is automatically removed.
data.help_content-tips-invite|contents[2].tex:
You can earn Invitation Rewards by entering an Invitation Code.
Invitation Rewards are granted to Gifts after the Invitation Code is entered.

◆Eligibility for Entry
- Managers within 30 days of starting the game
- Managers whose last login was 30 or more days ago
※Invitation Rewards can only be received once
※Invitation Codes can be entered after clearing Main Live #1
data.help_content-tips-panorama|contents[0].t: In addition to the Live Filming feature, you can film Live scenes using 5 types of cameras: Auto, Drone, Stage, Dedicated, and Audience.
data.help_content-tips-panorama|contents[1].t: The camera moves automatically in time with the Live Song.
data.help_content-tips-panorama|contents[2].t:
You can move the camera freely around the venue.
You can designate an Idol during the Live, and move the camera around the designated Idol.
You can select the camera movement speed from 3 types: slow, normal, and fast.
data.help_content-tips-panorama|contents[3].t:
You can freely move a camera along a fixed track on the Stage.
You can designate an Idol during the Live, and move the camera around the designated Idol.
You can select the camera movement speed from 3 types: slow, normal, and fast.
You can rotate the screen vertically.
data.help_content-tips-panorama|contents[4].t:
You can designate an Idol during the Live, and the camera automatically moves so that the designated Idol is centered on screen.
You can rotate the screen vertically.
data.help_content-tips-panorama|contents[5].t:
You can film the Live from the audience seats.
The types of audience seats differ by Stage, and you can select from 4 to 5 types.
You can designate an Idol during the Live, and the camera automatically moves so that the designated Idol is centered on screen.
data.help_content-tips-photo-expression|conte:
There are 4 types of photography: Live Photography, Job Photography, Pose Photography, and Story Photography.
A Photo's Quality, Rarity, and Options are determined at random.
The higher the Lv of the Photography Film used, the greater the chance of obtaining a high-Quality Photo.
"Developing" a Photo increases the Trust of the Idol who was the subject.
Please note that when developing a Photo taken in Story, the target Idol may not match the content of the Photo.

You can photograph a Live scene with the specified Members, Song, Costume, Hairstyle, and Venue to obtain a Photo.
Some Songs have Venues where photography is not possible.

You can photograph a Job scene (3D) with the specified Members, Job, Costume, and Hairstyle to obtain a Photo.
When photographing, turning Gyro ON lets you photograph using gyro controls.
Some Idols have Jobs where photography is not possible.

Rarity is drawn from among "★1 to ★5."

The Song, Stage, Job, or Story content being photographed does not affect Rarity.
The quality of the resulting Photo does not affect Rarity.

A Photo's Quality varies depending on the "Photography Film" used.
The higher the Lv of the Film, the more you can expect to obtain a high-Quality Photo.

The Song, Stage, Job, or Story content being photographed does not affect the Photo's Quality.
The quality of the resulting Photo does not affect the Photo's Quality.

When developing, the Trust of the Idol shown largest in the Photo increases.
As Trust increases, the content of messages you receive and the conversations on the Home screen change.

You can photograph the Main Story, Extra Story, and Idol Story to obtain Photos.
When developing a Photo taken in Story, the target Idol may not match the content of the Photo.
Please also note that some Films, such as the "Guaranteed Exclusive Photo Film" that obtains an Idol-exclusive Photo, cannot be used in Story Photography.

You can photograph a Job scene (3D) with the specified Members, Job, Costume, and Hairstyle to obtain a Photo.
When photographing, you can specify the Pose, Expression, Location, and Viewpoint.
Some Idols have Jobs where photography is not possible.
There are also Poses that cannot be used with certain Costumes, Hairstyles, or Jobs.
data.help_content-tips-roulette|contents[0].t:
The Roulette is a feature that lets you earn rewards by spinning the Roulette.
The Roulette can be spun for free once per day.
Also, by watching ads, you can spin the Roulette up to 3 additional times per day.
data.help_content-tips-roulette|contents[1].t:
Due to increased access or other reasons, it may take time before an ad is displayed.
If an ad does not display properly, please wait a little, restart the app, and try again.
On some devices or device settings, the ad feature may not work properly.
Please understand this in advance.
data.help_content-tips-showcase|contents[0].t:
You can freely display the in-game Goods you have obtained.

■Customize
You can freely display the in-game Goods you have obtained.
The number of Goods you can place may differ depending on the type of Case.

You can also set the Case's title, comment, BGM, thumbnail, and more.
Hashtags are automatically set based on the Goods placed in the Goods Case.

You can also film the Goods Case to obtain Photos.
When developing a Photo taken of a Goods Case, the target Idol may not match the Photo's contents.
Also, some films, such as the "Dedicated Photo Guaranteed Film" that lets you obtain an Idol-exclusive Photo, cannot be used for Goods photography. Please understand this in advance.

■Goods Shop
You can obtain Goods of your choice by consuming Goods Medals, Diamonds, and more.
In-game Goods can be obtained in duplicate, and you can place as many as you own in the Goods Case.
However, Figures, Cases, and BGM can only be owned one of each type.

■Gallery
You can view and like Goods Cases that other Managers have made public.
You cannot film other Managers' Goods Cases.

Also, if you like another Manager's Goods Case while you have a "Heart Gift", you can earn Friend Medals.
The Heart Gift possession limit is 30, and it recovers by 3 each day.
If you like without possessing a Heart Gift, you cannot earn Friend Medals.

Furthermore, when other Managers like you, you can earn Friend Medals on your first login the following day or later.
The maximum number of Friend Medals you can earn at that time is 10.

Note that a like you have given cannot be undone.
Likes you have given are reset on the 1st of every month, and you can like the same Case again. The Heart Gift possession limit is 30, and it recovers by 3 each day.
data.help_content-tips-showcase|contents[1].t:
You can freely display the in-game Goods you have obtained in the Goods Case.

■In-Game Goods
In-game Goods can be obtained from the various Goods Shops, Gacha, when obtaining Idols, various Event rewards, and more.
In-game Goods can be obtained in duplicate, and you can place as many as you own in the Goods Case.
However, Figures, Cases, and BGM can only be owned one of each type.

■Placement
In-game Goods can be placed on the "Floor" or "Wall" specified for each type of Goods.
The number of Goods you can place may differ depending on the type of Case.

■Pedestal
There are pedestals of multiple sizes.
By combining pedestals, you can create various placements.
When pedestals are placed side by side, Goods or pedestals cannot be placed on their boundary.
Also, some combinations of Goods or pedestals cannot be combined. Please understand this in advance.

■Case
A Case for placing Goods becomes usable after purchasing it at the Goods Case Shop.

■BGM
Played when filming the Goods Case or in the Gallery.
Only 1 Song can be set per Case.
data.help_content-tips-showcase|contents[2].t:
You can obtain Goods of your choice by consuming Goods Medals, Diamonds, and more.

■Various Shops
Displays Shops where you can purchase items usable in the Goods Case feature.

■Catalog
You can purchase various in-game Goods by consuming Goods Medals, Diamonds, and more.
Also, "Can Badge Packs" obtained from Shops and other sources can be opened from [Goods Shop > Open].

■Open
You can open various "Can Badge Packs".
In Can Badge Packs, you can randomly obtain the target Can Badges.
For the Can Badges you can obtain, please check the "Details" on the Can Badge Pack opening screen.
data.help_content-tips-showcase|contents[3].t:
You can view and like Goods Cases that other Managers have made public.
You cannot film other Managers' Goods Cases.

■Display of "Recommended" and "Friend" Goods Cases
You can check Goods Cases made public by other Managers and Goods Cases made public by Friends.

The Goods Cases displayed are drawn based on information such as
- the login status of the Case owner
- their editing status
- their like status
- their past display status.
The draw results differ by Manager and are updated several times a day.

■Various Search Displays
You can freely search Goods Cases using
- Friend Search
- ID Search
- Hashtag Search.

■Liking Other Managers
You can like other Managers' Cases.
If you like another Manager's Goods Case while you have a "Heart Gift", you can earn Friend Medals.
The Heart Gift possession limit is 30, and it recovers by 3 each day.
If you like without possessing a Heart Gift, you cannot earn Friend Medals.

Note that a like you have given cannot be undone.
Likes you have given are reset on the 1st of every month, and you can like the same Case again.

■Likes from Other Managers
When other Managers like you, you can earn Friend Medals on your first login the following day or later.
The maximum number of Friend Medals you can earn at that time is 10.

■Visibility to Other Managers
You can change the public setting from each Case's details.
Cases set to private are not displayed to other Managers.
